sources.quote: Recent Developments On October 29, 2020, we entered into a merger agreement (the “Merger Agreement”) with Inphi Corporation (“Inphi”), whereby we will pay Inphi's stockholders $66 per share in cash and 2.323 common shares for each Inphi share, which represented purchase consideration of approximately $10 billion as of that date.

deals.explain: Marvell bought Inphi, a maker of high-speed optical connection chips used inside data centers, for about $10B in cash and stock; the deal closed in April 2021. Those chips now carry much of the data between AI servers.

deals.title: Applied's raised $3.5B Kokusai Electric deal (terminated)

sources.quote: On January 1, 2021, the parties to the SPA entered into an amendment, pursuant to which they agreed, among other things, to extend the Outside Date to March 19, 2021 (Extended Outside Date); increase the base purchase price to $3.5 billion

Applied Materials, Inc. today announced that the amended Kokusai Electric Corporation share purchase agreement with KKR HKE Investment L.P. terminated as of March 19, 2021 as Applied did not receive confirmation of timely approval from the regulator in China.

deals.explain: Applied Materials raised its offer for Kokusai Electric to $3.5 billion while waiting for Chinese antitrust approval. The approval never came, the agreement expired in March 2021, and Applied paid KKR a $154 million termination fee instead of buying the company.

deals.title: Qualcomm buys CPU designer Nuvia for about $1.4B

sources.quote: Acquisitions On March 16, 2021 (the Closing Date), we completed the acquisition of NuVia, Inc. (NUVIA) for $1.1 billion (net of cash acquired), substantially all of which was paid in cash.

deals.explain: Qualcomm bought Nuvia, a startup founded by former Apple chip designers, to build its own high-performance processors. It was announced at about $1.4B; Qualcomm's filing shows $1.1B net of Nuvia's cash, the amount shown.

deals.title: Cisco raises Acacia purchase price to about $4.5B

sources.quote: Cisco has agreed to acquire Acacia for $115 per share in cash, or approximately $4.5 billion on a fully diluted basis, net of cash and marketable securities.

deals.explain: After Acacia tried to walk away from the original deal, Cisco agreed to pay $115 a share (about $4.5 billion), up from $70. The deal closed in March 2021, giving Cisco its own coherent optics for data center and network links.

deals.title: SK hynix signs ~$4.3B, five-year EUV tool deal with ASML

sources.quote: SK Hynix, world's second-largest memory chip maker, said on Wednesday it had agreed a five-year procurement contract worth 4.8 trillion won ($4.34 billion) with ASML Holding N.V. to secure extreme ultraviolet (EUV) scanners used in manufacturing chips.
SK Hynix said on Wednesday that it will be spending 4.75 trillion won (around US$4.3 billion) up to December 1, 2025 to procure extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment.

deals.explain: SK hynix agreed to buy EUV lithography machines, the most advanced chipmaking tools, which only ASML makes, for about 4.75 trillion won (about $4.3 billion) over five years through 2025, to produce advanced DRAM memory. The figure comes from SK hynix's Korean regulatory filing as reported by news outlets.

deals.title: Nvidia invests in VAST Data's $83M Series D

sources.quote: The round features strong participation from NVIDIA and several other existing investors, and is driven by VAST’s unique combination of rapid customer adoption and positive cash flow.

deals.explain: Nvidia was a major participant in VAST Data's $83 million funding round led by Tiger Global, which valued the storage software company at $3.7 billion. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: AMD to buy ~$1.6B of GlobalFoundries wafers in 2022-2024

sources.quote: The Company currently estimates that it will purchase approximately $1.6 billion of wafers from GF for years 2022 to 2024 under the A&R Seventh Amendment.

deals.explain: AMD restated its wafer supply agreement with GlobalFoundries, setting yearly purchase targets for 2022-2024 that AMD estimated at about $1.6 billion in total. Seven months later the two expanded it to about $2.1 billion through 2025.

deals.title: Blackstone buys QTS data centers for $10B

sources.publisher: QTS Realty Trust Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
sources.quote: Blackstone (NYSE: BX) and QTS Realty Trust (NYSE: QTS) today announced that affiliates of Blackstone Infrastructure Partners, Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust, Inc., and Blackstone Property Partners have completed their previously announced acquisition of QTS Realty Trust for approximately $10 billion, including debt.

deals.explain: Blackstone funds bought data center owner QTS for about $10 billion including debt, then poured money into it; QTS became one of the largest builders of data centers leased to cloud and AI companies.

deals.title: AWS named first customer of Intel's foundry packaging services

sources.quote: Intel announced that AWS will be the first customer to use IFS packaging solutions

deals.explain: Amazon Web Services became the first customer for Intel Foundry Services' advanced chip packaging, which joins multiple chip pieces into one package. It was an early sign of outside demand for Intel's foundry push; terms were not disclosed.

deals.title: Marvell buys Innovium for $1.1B

sources.quote: Under the terms of the definitive agreement, Innovium shareholders will receive $1.1 billion in consideration consisting of approximately 19.05 million shares of Marvell Common Stock that will be issued in aggregate in exchange for all outstanding equity of Innovium

deals.explain: Marvell bought Innovium, a startup making network switch chips for cloud data centers, for about $1.1B paid in Marvell stock.

deals.title: Vertiv buys switchgear maker E&I Engineering for $1.8B

sources.quote: it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire E&I Engineering Ireland Limited and its affiliate, Powerbar Gulf LLC
for approximately $1.8 billion in upfront consideration plus the potential for up to $200 million in cash, based on achieving certain 2022 profit milestones.

deals.explain: Vertiv paid about $1.8 billion in cash and stock (plus up to $200 million more tied to 2022 profits) for E&I Engineering, an Irish maker of switchgear and busway that distributes electricity inside data centers. The deal closed in November 2021.

deals.title: Lumentum buys optical components maker NeoPhotonics for $918M

sources.quote: today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement under which Lumentum will acquire NeoPhotonics for $16.00 per share in cash, which represents a total equity value of approximately $918 million.

deals.explain: Lumentum paid NeoPhotonics shareholders $16 a share in cash, about $918 million, for its lasers and optical parts used in high-speed data center and telecom links. The deal closed in August 2022.

deals.title: KKR and GIP buy CyrusOne for $15B

sources.quote: today announced the completion of its acquisition by funds managed by KKR, a leading global investment firm, and Global Infrastructure Partners ("GIP"), one of the world's leading infrastructure investors, in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $15 billion, including the assumption of debt (the "Transaction").

deals.explain: KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners (now part of BlackRock) bought data center operator CyrusOne for about $15 billion including debt; the deal closed in March 2022. The full price is shown on this KKR record.

deals.title: AMD raises GlobalFoundries wafer commitment to ~$2.1B through 2025

sources.quote: The Company currently estimates that it will purchase approximately $2.1 billion of wafers in total from GF for years 2022 through 2025 under the Amendment.

deals.explain: AMD amended its wafer deal with GlobalFoundries during the 2021 chip shortage, lifting its expected purchases to about $2.1 billion of wafers over 2022-2025 in exchange for more guaranteed capacity. It replaces the earlier $1.6 billion estimate.

deals.title: Intel places first order for ASML's High-NA EUV production tool

sources.quote: Intel has issued its first purchase order to ASML for the delivery of the industry

deals.explain: Intel ordered ASML's first TWINSCAN EXE:5200, a next-generation High-NA EUV lithography machine for printing the tiniest chip features. Each machine is reported to cost several hundred million dollars, but the order value was not disclosed.

deals.title: Intel's $5.4B deal to buy Tower Semiconductor (canceled)

sources.quote: Intel Corporation (Nasdaq: INTC) and Tower Semiconductor (Nasdaq: TSEM), a leading foundry for analog semiconductor solutions, today announced a definitive agreement under which Intel will acquire Tower for $53 per share in cash, representing a total enterprise value of approximately $5.4 billion.
Pursuant to the terms of the merger agreement, and in connection with this termination, Intel will pay to Tower a reverse termination fee equal to $353 million.

deals.explain: Intel agreed to buy Israeli contract chipmaker Tower Semiconductor for about $5.4 billion to grow its foundry business. The deal was called off in August 2023 after Intel failed to get a required regulatory approval (China) in time, so this money never moved.

deals.title: AMD buys Pensando for $1.9B

sources.quote: NOTE 14 – Subsequent Events On April 3, 2022, the Company entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Pensando Systems, Inc., for $1.9 billion (Pensando Merger), subject to certain working capital adjustments.

deals.explain: AMD bought Pensando, a maker of data-center networking chips (DPUs) that offload work from servers, for about $1.9B. Pensando's technology now goes into AMD's AI server racks.

deals.title: DigitalBridge and IFM take Switch private for $11B

sources.quote: funds affiliated with the investment management platform of DigitalBridge and an affiliate of IFM Investors acquired all outstanding common shares of Switch, Inc.
for $34.25 per share in cash, or approximately $11 billion, including the repayment of outstanding debt.

deals.explain: DigitalBridge's investment funds and Australian pension investor IFM bought data center operator Switch for $34.25 a share, about $11 billion including debt. The full price is shown on this record; IFM's share is not split out.

deals.title: MediaTek signs on as Intel Foundry Services customer

sources.quote: IFS recently announced a strategic partnership with MediaTek to manufacture chips for a range of smart edge devices using Intel process technologies.

deals.explain: Taiwanese chip designer MediaTek agreed to have Intel manufacture some of its chips for smart devices, one of the first big outside customers for Intel's contract manufacturing (foundry) business. Financial terms were not disclosed.

deals.title: Qualcomm more than doubles GlobalFoundries supply deal through 2028

sources.quote: Multi-billion dollar revenue agreement increases global supply capacity reservation to cover multiple technologies

deals.explain: Qualcomm agreed to more than double its long-term wafer purchase agreement with GlobalFoundries, reserving factory capacity through 2028, including at GF's Malta, New York fab. GF called it a multi-billion-dollar revenue agreement but gave no exact figure.

deals.title: Brookfield to fund 49% of up to $30B Intel Arizona fabs

sources.quote: Signs Agreement with Brookfield to Jointly Invest up to $30 Billion in Leading-Edge Chip Factories in Arizona
previously announced manufacturing expansion at its Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona, with Intel funding 51% and Brookfield funding 49% of the total project cost.

deals.explain: Brookfield's infrastructure arm agreed to pay 49% of the cost of Intel's new chip factories in Chandler, Arizona, a project of up to $30 billion. The amount shown is 49% of $30 billion ($14.7 billion), a ceiling.

deals.title: Kioxia among eight Japanese companies funding Rapidus launch

sources.quote: The companies – Toyota, Sony, NTT, SoftBank, Kioxia, Denso, NEC and MUFG Bank – have invested a total of 7.3 billion yen (about US$51.5 million) to create the company, the reports said.

deals.explain: Memory maker Kioxia was one of eight Japanese companies that put a combined 7.3 billion yen (about $51.5 million) into Rapidus, the new company trying to bring 2nm chipmaking to Japan. Kioxia's individual share was not disclosed; most Rapidus funding comes from the Japanese government.

deals.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise invests in WEKA's $135M Series D

sources.quote: Several notable new and existing investors also contributed, including 10D, Atreides Management, Celesta Capital, Gemini Israel Ventures, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Hitachi Ventures, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, Micron Ventures, Mirae Asset Capital, MoreTech Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, NVIDIA, Qualcomm Ventures, and Samsung Catalyst Fund.

deals.explain: Hewlett Packard Enterprise, which sells servers and storage that can run WEKA's software, invested in WEKA's $135 million round. HPE's amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Micron Ventures invests in WEKA's $135M Series D

sources.quote: Several notable new and existing investors also contributed, including 10D, Atreides Management, Celesta Capital, Gemini Israel Ventures, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Hitachi Ventures, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, Micron Ventures, Mirae Asset Capital, MoreTech Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, NVIDIA, Qualcomm Ventures, and Samsung Catalyst Fund.

deals.explain: Micron's venture arm invested in WEKA, a storage software company whose systems run on memory and flash drives like the ones Micron makes. The amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia invests in WEKA's $135M Series D

sources.quote: Several notable new and existing investors also contributed, including 10D, Atreides Management, Celesta Capital, Gemini Israel Ventures, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Hitachi Ventures, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, Micron Ventures, Mirae Asset Capital, MoreTech Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, NVIDIA, Qualcomm Ventures, and Samsung Catalyst Fund.

deals.explain: Nvidia was one of many investors in WEKA's $135 million round led by Generation Investment Management. WEKA's software keeps GPUs supplied with data; Nvidia's amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Qualcomm Ventures invests in WEKA's $135M Series D

sources.quote: Several notable new and existing investors also contributed, including 10D, Atreides Management, Celesta Capital, Gemini Israel Ventures, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Hitachi Ventures, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, Micron Ventures, Mirae Asset Capital, MoreTech Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, NVIDIA, Qualcomm Ventures, and Samsung Catalyst Fund.

deals.explain: Qualcomm's venture arm invested in WEKA's $135 million round led by Generation Investment Management. The amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Samsung Catalyst Fund invests in WEKA's $135M Series D

sources.quote: Several notable new and existing investors also contributed, including 10D, Atreides Management, Celesta Capital, Gemini Israel Ventures, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Hitachi Ventures, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, Micron Ventures, Mirae Asset Capital, MoreTech Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, NVIDIA, Qualcomm Ventures, and Samsung Catalyst Fund.

deals.explain: Samsung's venture fund invested in WEKA's $135 million round. WEKA's data storage software runs on flash drives like those Samsung makes; the amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Apple commits to buy chips from TSMC's Arizona fab

sources.quote: Cook said Apple would buy processors made in a new Arizona factory, according to a video from the event.
That includes TSMC in Arizona, which is producing tens of millions of chips for Apple using one of the most advanced process technologies in America.

deals.explain: Apple, long TSMC's biggest customer, committed in 2022 to buy chips from TSMC's new factories in Phoenix, Arizona, and by 2025 said it was the fab's first and largest customer. The size of Apple's orders is not disclosed.

deals.title: Microsoft deepens OpenAI investment in multiyear deal

sources.quote: This agreement follows our previous investments in 2019 and 2021.
We have an investment in OpenAI Global, LLC (“OpenAI”) and have made total funding commitments of $13 billion, of which $11.6 billion has been funded as of September 30, 2025.

deals.explain: In January 2023 Microsoft announced a new multiyear, multibillion-dollar investment in OpenAI (widely reported at about $10 billion, but Microsoft did not give a number). Counting 2019, 2021 and 2023, Microsoft says it committed $13 billion in total, of which $11.6 billion had been paid by September 2025.

deals.title: Anthropic picks Google Cloud as its preferred cloud provider

sources.quote: Anthropic has selected Google Cloud as its preferred cloud provider, giving it the compute power necessary to build reliable and trustworthy AI systems.

deals.explain: Early in its life Anthropic chose Google Cloud as its preferred provider of computing power for training its Claude models. No amount was disclosed; Google was also an early investor.

deals.title: Vistra acquires Energy Harbor and its nuclear fleet for $3B cash

sources.quote: Total compensation will consist of $3 billion cash and a 15% equity interest in Vistra Vision.

deals.explain: Vistra paid Energy Harbor's owners $3 billion in cash plus a 15% stake in its new Vistra Vision unit (and took on ~$430M of debt) for Energy Harbor's nuclear and retail businesses. That deal gave Vistra the Ohio and Pennsylvania nuclear plants it later contracted to Meta. Plants acquired: Perry, Davis-Besse and Beaver Valley nuclear plants.

deals.title: Nvidia rents CoreWeave cloud capacity, ~$320M paid by 2024

sources.quote: As of December 31, 2024, NVIDIA has paid us an aggregate of approximately $320 million pursuant to the Master Services Agreement and related order forms.

deals.explain: Under a master services agreement signed in April 2023, Nvidia rents computing capacity from CoreWeave; by the end of 2024 it had paid about $320 million. Nvidia is CoreWeave's chip supplier, shareholder and customer at the same time.

deals.title: Nvidia invests ~$100M in CoreWeave's Series B

sources.quote: The round was led by Magnetar Capital ("Magnetar"), a leading alternative asset manager, with contributions from NVIDIA, and rounded out by Nat Friedman and Daniel Gross.
Nvidia has invested $100 million in CoreWeave, which in April was valued at $2 billion.

deals.explain: Nvidia put money into CoreWeave's $221 million Series B round in April 2023; CNBC reported Nvidia's stake at about $100 million. This early bet tied the chip maker to one of its largest GPU buyers.

deals.title: Character.AI picks Google Cloud to build and train its AI models

sources.quote: today announced a strategic partnership with Google Cloud and has selected it as its preferred cloud infrastructure to build and train sophisticated AI models with advanced reasoning and greater accuracy.

deals.explain: Chatbot startup Character.AI chose Google Cloud's AI chips and services to build and train its models. No amount was disclosed.

deals.title: Microsoft signs first fusion power purchase agreement with Helion

sources.quote: Today we announced that Microsoft has agreed to purchase electricity from Helion’s first fusion power plant, scheduled for deployment in 2028.
Photo courtesy Helion Microsoft said Wednesday it has signed a power purchase agreement with nuclear fusion startup Helion Energy to buy electricity from it in 2028.

deals.explain: Microsoft agreed to buy electricity from Helion's first fusion power plant, targeted for 2028 in Washington state (reported as at least 50 MW). It was the first-ever fusion power purchase agreement; financial terms were not disclosed. Plant: Helion's planned Orion fusion plant, Malaga, Washington (not yet operating).

deals.title: Apple signs multibillion-dollar deal for Broadcom US-made components

sources.quote: Today Apple announced a new multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement with Broadcom, a leading U.S. technology and advanced manufacturing company.

deals.explain: Apple agreed to buy 5G radio parts and wireless chips designed and made by Broadcom in the US over several years. Apple called it 'multibillion-dollar' but gave no exact number.

deals.title: Microsoft agrees to spend potentially billions on CoreWeave

sources.quote: CNBC has learned from people with knowledge of the matter that Microsoft has agreed to spend potentially billions of dollars over multiple years on cloud computing infrastructure from startup CoreWeave, which announced Wednesday that it raised $200 million.
For the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, our largest customer was Microsoft, which accounted for 35% and 62% of our revenue, respectively.

deals.explain: Microsoft rents GPU computing from CoreWeave, largely to meet OpenAI's demand. No contract total was published, but Microsoft made up 62% of CoreWeave's 2024 revenue, making it CoreWeave's biggest customer.

deals.title: Blackstone and Magnetar lead $2.3B loan to CoreWeave

sources.quote: The funding was led by Magnetar Capital and funds managed by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities ("Blackstone") with strategic participation from leading asset management firms Coatue and DigitalBridge Credit, and funds and accounts managed by BlackRock, PIMCO, and Carlyle.

deals.explain: Blackstone and Magnetar led a $2.3 billion loan to CoreWeave, used mainly to buy GPU servers needed to serve customer contracts. The amount is the whole loan, including other lenders; it was fully drawn by the end of 2024.

deals.title: Intel pays Tower $353M fee after scrapped takeover

sources.quote: In accordance with the terms of the merger agreement and in connection with its termination, Intel will pay a termination fee of $353 million to Tower.

The 2023 charges also included a $353 million termination fee in connection with our inability to timely obtain required regulatory approvals needed to acquire Tower in accordance with the contractual terms of the terminated acquisition agreement and a $401 million charge for the original EC-imposed fine.

deals.explain: When Intel's planned purchase of Tower Semiconductor collapsed for lack of regulatory approval, Intel owed Tower a $353 million break-up fee under the merger contract. This is the only money that actually changed hands in the failed takeover.

deals.title: Google commits up to $2B to Anthropic

sources.quote: In September 2023, the Company entered into a note purchase agreement (“Google 2023 NPA”) with Google LLC (“Google”), for the issuance of convertible promissory notes in an aggregate principal amount of up to $2.0 billion, issuable in three tranches.
As of December 31, 2025, $750 million aggregate principal amount remained outstanding under the third tranche of notes issued under Google 2023 NPA.

deals.explain: In September 2023 Google agreed to lend Anthropic up to $2 billion in three parts through convertible notes, which later turned into Anthropic shares. Anthropic's IPO filing gives only the month, so the date here is the first of September 2023.

deals.title: Tower books Intel foundry capacity in New Mexico

sources.quote: Under the agreement, Tower will utilize Intel’s advanced manufacturing facility in New Mexico.

deals.explain: Weeks after their merger fell apart, Tower agreed to pay Intel for foundry services: Intel runs 300mm chip production for Tower at its New Mexico fab. Tower separately said it would spend up to $300 million on equipment it owns inside that fab; the fees paid to Intel were not disclosed.

deals.title: TSMC buys 10% of Intel's IMS Nanofabrication unit

sources.quote: Approved the purchase of 10% equity interest in IMS Nanofabrication Global, LLC from Intel Corporation for an amount not exceeding US$432.8 million.

In 2023, we closed agreements to sell a combined 32% minority stake in our IMS business, a business within our Intel Foundry operating segment—including a 20% stake to Bain Capital Special Situations and a 10% stake to TSMC.

deals.explain: TSMC paid Intel for a 10% stake in IMS Nanofabrication, an Intel-owned Austrian company that makes the multi-beam machines used to write chip photomasks. TSMC's board capped the price at $432.8 million; the sale closed in 2023.

deals.title: G42 orders ~$389M of Cerebras supercomputers

sources.quote: Under the Framework Agreement, we are entitled to receive an aggregate of approximately $389.0 million upon performance of purchase orders

deals.explain: Abu Dhabi's G42 signed a framework deal in September 2023 to buy Cerebras AI supercomputers (the Condor Galaxy systems), worth about $389M. G42 became Cerebras's biggest customer by far.

deals.title: Amazon invests $4B in Anthropic

sources.quote: Amazon will invest up to $4 billion in Anthropic and have a minority ownership position in the company.
Today, we made our additional $2.75 billion investment, bringing our total investment in Anthropic to $4 billion.
In Q3 2023, we invested $1.25 billion in a convertible note from Anthropic, PBC.

deals.explain: Amazon announced up to $4 billion for Anthropic in September 2023, paid $1.25 billion first and the remaining $2.75 billion in March 2024. In return Anthropic made Amazon's AWS its main cloud provider.

deals.title: Anthropic names AWS its primary cloud provider

sources.quote: AWS will become Anthropic’s primary cloud provider for mission critical workloads, including safety research and future foundation model development.

deals.explain: Alongside Amazon's first investment in Anthropic, Anthropic agreed to run most of its work on Amazon's cloud and use Amazon's Trainium and Inferentia chips. The cloud spending amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: CoreWeave picks VAST Data to store data across all its data centers

sources.quote: CoreWeave did extensive research and testing before selecting VAST Data to power all of its data centers.

deals.explain: CoreWeave chose VAST Data's storage software for all of its GPU data centers, making it a paying VAST customer. No price was given; the relationship was expanded into a $1.17 billion deal in 2025.

deals.title: Lambda selects VAST Data to power its GPU cloud storage

sources.quote: Lambda has selected the VAST Data Platform, the data platform designed from the ground up for the AI era, to power Lambda’s On-Demand GPU Cloud, providing customers with the fastest and most optimized GPU deployments for Large Language Model (LLM) training and inference workloads in the market.

deals.explain: Lambda, a GPU cloud company, chose VAST Data's storage software for its on-demand GPU cloud, so Lambda pays VAST for the storage layer its AI customers use. No price was disclosed.

deals.title: Lumentum buys optical transceiver maker Cloud Light for $750M

sources.quote: Under terms of the merger agreement, Lumentum acquired Cloud Light with a transaction value of approximately $750 million, before certain adjustments.

deals.explain: Lumentum paid about $750 million in cash for Cloud Light, a Hong Kong-based maker of optical transceivers (the plug-in modules that turn electrical signals into light) used inside AI data centers. Announced in October 2023 and closed in November 2023.

deals.title: Compass Datacenters signs $3B multi-year equipment deal with Schneider

sources.quote: today announced at its Capital Markets Day meeting with investors a $3 billion multi-year agreement with Compass Datacenters.

deals.explain: Data center builder Compass agreed to buy about $3 billion of prefabricated modular power and data center equipment from Schneider Electric over several years. Schneider builds the modules in US factories and ships them to Compass sites, which speeds up construction.

deals.title: Apple becomes first and largest customer of Amkor's Arizona packaging plant

sources.quote: Amkor Technology, a semiconductor packaging provider, got Apple as its first and biggest customer for its advanced packaging facility being built in Peoria, Arizona.
Apple is investing in Amkor’s new advanced chip packaging and test facility in Arizona, and will be its first and largest customer.

deals.explain: Amkor is building a roughly $2 billion chip packaging and testing plant near Phoenix, and Apple committed to be its first and largest customer, paying Amkor to package Apple chips made at TSMC's nearby Arizona fab. Apple also said in 2025 that it is investing in the facility. Amounts were not disclosed.

deals.title: Vertiv buys UK liquid-cooling firm CoolTera

sources.quote: today announced that subsidiaries of the company have entered into a definitive agreement to acquire all of the shares of CoolTera Ltd. (CoolTera), a provider of coolant distribution infrastructure for data center liquid cooling technology

Our fourth quarter acquisition of CoolTera and our continued commitment to supporting our customers reinforce our strong position in liquid cooling for high density compute applications driven by AI demand.

deals.explain: Vertiv bought CoolTera, a UK company that designs coolant distribution units, the pumps and heat exchangers that feed liquid to AI server racks. The price was not disclosed.

deals.title: HPE buys Juniper Networks for about $14B

sources.quote: HPE will acquire Juniper in an all-cash transaction for $40.00 per share, representing an equity value of approximately $14 billion

On July 2, 2025, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (“HPE” or the “Company”), Juniper Networks, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Juniper”) and Jasmine Acquisition Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of HPE (“Merger Sub”), completed the transactions contemplated by the previously announced Agreement and Plan of Merger

deals.explain: Server maker HPE paid Juniper's shareholders about $14 billion in cash to buy the networking company, roughly doubling HPE's networking business as AI data centers need more switches and routers. The deal was agreed in January 2024 and closed in July 2025 after a US antitrust settlement.

deals.title: Equinix signs letter of intent to buy up to 500 MW from Oklo reactors

sources.quote: On February 16, 2024 (the “LOI Execution Date”), Legacy Oklo entered into that certain Confidential Letter of Intent to Purchase Power, dated as of February 16, 2024, by and between Legacy Oklo and Equinix (the "February 2024 LOI"), which confirms Equinix’s interest in purchasing power from our powerhouses to serve its data centers in the United States.

deals.explain: Data center operator Equinix signed a non-binding letter of intent to buy 100-500 MW from Oklo's planned Aurora reactors over 20 years, with a right of first refusal. Oklo's 10-K notes a matching February 16, 2024 letter of intent with an unnamed party that paid Oklo $25,000 (in thousands, about $25 million) for these rights; that link is our reading, so the amount is left undisclosed. Plants: future Oklo Aurora powerhouses (not yet built).

deals.title: Microsoft picks Intel 18A to manufacture a custom chip

sources.quote: This quarter, Microsoft also announced its plans to design a chip on Intel 18A.

deals.explain: At Intel's foundry launch event in February 2024, Microsoft said it would have one of its own chip designs manufactured on Intel's 18A process. It was a marquee customer win for Intel's contract manufacturing business; the value was not disclosed.

deals.title: Microsoft invests €15M in Mistral AI

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, Microsoft is investing €15 million ($16.3 million at today’s exchange rate) in the French startup.

deals.explain: Microsoft made a small €15 million (about $16.3 million) investment in Mistral as part of a deal to offer Mistral's models on its Azure cloud. It was small in money but drew attention from European regulators.

deals.title: Micron HBM3E memory goes into Nvidia's H200 GPUs

sources.publisher: Edge AI and Vision Alliance (Micron release)
sources.quote: Micron’s 24GB 8H HBM3E will be part of NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs, which will begin shipping in the second calendar quarter of 2024.
Micron’s 24GB 8-high HBM3E is shipping with NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs and production-capable 36GB 12-high HBM3E is also available.

deals.explain: Nvidia buys high-bandwidth memory (HBM, the fast memory stacked next to the GPU) from Micron for its H200 AI chips. Micron began volume production for Nvidia in early 2024; the value was not disclosed.

deals.title: AWS buys Talen's Cumulus data center campus next to Susquehanna for $650M

sources.quote: In March 2024, AWS purchased substantially all the assets of Cumulus Data and certain other assets for gross proceeds of $650 million.
Cumulus Digital (a Talen subsidiary) has now received all funds previously held in escrow under the terms of the transaction.

deals.explain: Amazon Web Services paid Talen $650 million for the Cumulus data center campus (land, power infrastructure and buildings) next to the Susquehanna nuclear plant in Pennsylvania; $300M was held in escrow until development milestones were met in August 2024. Plant next door: Susquehanna Steam Electric Station.

deals.title: AWS signs PPA for up to 960 MW from Talen's Susquehanna nuclear plant

sources.quote: Under the AWS PPA, AWS has minimum contractual power commitments that increase in 120 MW increments annually (or earlier, at AWS’s option), with a one-time option to either cap commitments at 480 MW or otherwise purchase, in continuing annual steps, up to 960 MW.

deals.explain: Alongside buying the Cumulus data center campus in March 2024, AWS signed a fixed-price deal (initial term 18 years) to buy power directly from Talen's Susquehanna nuclear plant, ramping up to 960 MW. It was replaced in June 2025 by a larger 1,920 MW grid-connected PPA. Plant: Susquehanna Steam Electric Station, Pennsylvania.

deals.title: Microsoft pays ~$650M to license Inflection's AI

sources.quote: has agreed to pay AI startup Inflection about $650 million in cash in an unusual deal that would allow Microsoft to use Inflection’s models and hire most of the startup’s staff including its co-founders, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday.
According to The Information, Microsoft has agreed to pay approximately $650 million to Inflection AI.

deals.explain: Microsoft hired Inflection's founders and most of its staff and paid the startup about $650 million, mostly as a fee to license its AI models. The amount comes from people familiar with the deal; Microsoft did not confirm it.

deals.title: Microsoft invests $1.5B in G42

sources.quote: G42, the leading UAE-based artificial intelligence (AI) technology holding company, and Microsoft today announced a $1.5 billion strategic investment by Microsoft in G42.

deals.explain: Microsoft bought a $1.5 billion minority stake in Abu Dhabi's G42, which agreed to run its AI work on Microsoft's Azure cloud. The deal was shaped with the US and UAE governments, after G42 cut ties with Chinese hardware suppliers.

deals.title: G42 commits to buy $1.43B of Cerebras systems

sources.quote: The $1.43 billion of products and services that G42 has committed to purchase pursuant to the G42 May 2024 Agreement (as defined in “Management’s Discussion & Analysis—G42 Relationship”) does not count toward the G42 Option Threshold.

deals.explain: In May 2024, G42 committed to buy about $1.43B more of Cerebras computing systems and services by early 2025 (part was later bought by the Abu Dhabi AI university MBZUAI). Exact signing day in May was not given, so the date is approximate.

deals.title: G42 agrees to buy $335M of Cerebras stock

sources.quote: Pursuant to the Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement, G42 agreed to purchase an aggregate of approximately 22.9 million shares of our Series F-2 redeemable convertible preferred stock (or, if purchased following the completion of this offering, shares of our Class N common stock) at $14.66 per share, for anticipated gross proceeds to us of $335.0 million (the “G42 Primary Purchase”).

deals.explain: Besides buying Cerebras systems, G42 agreed in May 2024 to invest $335M in Cerebras non-voting shares, a deal reviewed by the US national-security body CFIUS. Exact signing day in May was not given, so the date is approximate.

deals.title: Microsoft and Brookfield sign 10.5 GW renewable energy framework

sources.quote: The agreement provides a pathway for Brookfield to deliver over 10.5 gigawatts of new renewable energy capacity between 2026 and 2030 in the U.S. and Europe.

deals.explain: A framework under which Brookfield plans to build over 10.5 GW of new wind, solar and other carbon-free capacity in the U.S. and Europe in 2026-2030 for Microsoft to buy. Individual contracts and prices were not disclosed (press reports estimated about $10B, not confirmed by the companies). Plants: future Brookfield projects, not named.

deals.title: Nvidia joins WEKA's $140M Series E

sources.quote: Generation Investment Management, NVIDIA, Atreides Management, 10D, Hitachi Ventures, Ibex Investors, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, MoreTech Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures joined Valor in contributing to the round.

deals.explain: Nvidia invested again in WEKA, which makes software that feeds data to GPUs fast enough for AI training. The $140 million round, led by Valor Equity Partners, valued WEKA at $1.6 billion; Nvidia's share was not disclosed.

deals.title: Qualcomm Ventures joins WEKA's $140M Series E

sources.quote: Generation Investment Management, NVIDIA, Atreides Management, 10D, Hitachi Ventures, Ibex Investors, Key1 Capital, Lumir Ventures, MoreTech Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures joined Valor in contributing to the round.

deals.explain: Qualcomm's venture arm took part in WEKA's $140 million round at a $1.6 billion valuation. WEKA sells data storage software used in AI clusters; Qualcomm's amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Blackstone and Magnetar lead $7.6B loan to CoreWeave

sources.quote: Our recent raise of $7.6 billion in committed GPU infrastructure-backed debt led by Blackstone and Magnetar represents one of the largest private debt financings in history and signals the confidence that debt investors have in funding our company to build and scale the next generation AI cloud.

deals.explain: Blackstone funds and Magnetar led a $7.6 billion GPU-backed loan facility for CoreWeave (reported as $7.5 billion in May 2024 and later amended), used mainly to buy GPU servers for customer contracts. The amount is the whole facility, including other lenders.

deals.title: a16z invests in xAI's Series B

sources.quote: Our Series B funding round of $6 billion with participation from key investors including Valor Equity Partners, Vy Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal and Kingdom Holding, amongst others.

deals.explain: Andreessen Horowitz took part in xAI's $6 billion Series B (counted in full on the Valor record); its own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Sequoia invests in xAI's Series B

sources.quote: Our Series B funding round of $6 billion with participation from key investors including Valor Equity Partners, Vy Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal and Kingdom Holding, amongst others.

deals.explain: Sequoia took part in xAI's $6 billion Series B (counted in full on the Valor record); its own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Valor-backed $6B Series B for xAI

sources.quote: Our Series B funding round of $6 billion with participation from key investors including Valor Equity Partners, Vy Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal and Kingdom Holding, amongst others.

deals.explain: xAI raised $6 billion from Valor Equity Partners, Vy Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia, Fidelity and others. xAI named no lead; the whole round is shown on this Valor record (Valor is listed first) and each investor's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: CoreWeave signs 12-year, ~200 MW hosting deals with Core Scientific (>$3.5B)

sources.quote: Once the approximately 200 MW of HPC infrastructure is operational, the project is estimated to generate total cumulative revenue for Core Scientific of over $3.5 billion during the initial 12-year terms of the contracts.

deals.explain: CoreWeave agreed to rent about 200 megawatts of converted bitcoin-mining sites from Core Scientific for 12 years to house its Nvidia GPUs. Core Scientific expects more than $3.5 billion in revenue over the contracts.

deals.title: Apollo pays $11B for 49% of Intel's Ireland fab venture

sources.quote: Intel Corporation (Nasdaq: INTC) and Apollo (NYSE: APO) today announced a definitive agreement under which Apollo-managed funds and affiliates will lead an investment of $11 billion to acquire from Intel a 49% equity interest in a joint venture entity related to Intel’s Fab 34.

deals.explain: Apollo-managed funds led an $11 billion payment to Intel for a 49% share of the joint venture that owns Intel's Fab 34 chip factory in Ireland, letting Intel raise cash without selling stock. The amount includes Apollo's co-investors.

deals.title: OpenAI taps Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for extra Azure AI capacity

sources.quote: Oracle, Microsoft, and OpenAl are partnering to extend the Microsoft Azure Al platform to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) to provide additional capacity for OpenAl.

deals.explain: OpenAI's first deal to use Oracle's cloud: Oracle supplied extra AI computing that plugged into Microsoft's Azure platform. No amount was given; it was the start of a relationship that grew into the much larger Stargate contracts.

deals.title: CoreWeave exercises option for ~70 MW more at Core Scientific ($1.225B)

sources.quote: From revenue to gross margin, the new contract with CoreWeave is expected to enhance earnings power and drive shareholder value, adding an additional $1.225 billion in projected cumulative revenue over the 12-year contract timeline to the more than $3.5 billion in projected cumulative revenue associated with previously announced contracts with CoreWeave.

deals.explain: CoreWeave used an option in its earlier deal to rent about 70 more megawatts from Core Scientific for 12 years, adding about $1.2 billion of expected revenue.

deals.title: Nokia buys optical networking firm Infinera for $2.3B

sources.quote: today announced a definitive agreement under which Nokia will acquire Infinera in a transaction valuing the company at $6.65 per share or an enterprise value of US$ 2.3 billion.
Infinera acquisition completed during Q1, increasing Nokia's scale in Optical Networks and with hyperscalers.

deals.explain: Nokia paid $6.65 a share, mostly in cash, for Infinera, a US maker of optical networking equipment that carries data between data centers. Nokia said it wanted more scale selling to hyperscalers (the giant cloud companies). The deal closed in February 2025.

deals.title: Google invests about $1.3B more in Anthropic

sources.quote: In August 2024, the Company entered into an additional note purchase agreement (“Google 2024 NPA”) with Google for the issuance of a convertible promissory note in an aggregate principal amount of approximately $1.3 billion.

deals.explain: Google added about $1.3 billion to Anthropic in a convertible note signed in August 2024 (the filing gives only the month, so the date here is the first of August). The note became Anthropic shares in 2025.

deals.title: Google pays ~$2.7B to license Character.AI tech

sources.quote: As part of the deal, Google paid $2.7 billion to license Character.AI's technology and bring Shazeer back into the fold, The Wall Street Journal noted.
Google wrote Character a check for around $2.7 billion, according to people with knowledge of the deal.

deals.explain: Google paid Character.AI a reported $2.7 billion licensing fee for its chatbot technology and rehired its founders, including Noam Shazeer. Licensing instead of buying let Google skip a full merger review. The amount comes from Wall Street Journal sources, not the companies.

deals.title: CoreWeave exercises option for ~112 MW more at Core Scientific (~$2.0B)

sources.quote: The new contract with CoreWeave is expected to add approximately $2.0 billion in projected additional cumulative revenue over the hosting contract’s 12-year term to the more than $4.7 billion in projected cumulative revenue associated with previously announced contracts with CoreWeave, for a total of $6.7 billion.

deals.explain: CoreWeave exercised a second option to rent about 112 more megawatts at Core Scientific sites for 12 years, adding roughly $2 billion of expected revenue.

deals.title: CoreWeave picks Bloom fuel cells to power an Illinois AI data center

sources.quote: Announced agreement with CoreWeave, a leader in AI, to power the high-performance data center owned by Chirisa Technology Parks located in Volo, Illinois.

deals.explain: AI cloud provider CoreWeave agreed to use Bloom Energy fuel cells for on-site power at a data center in Volo, Illinois owned by Chirisa Technology Parks. Terms were not disclosed; the date used is when Bloom reported the agreement in its Q2 2024 results, which may be later than the original announcement. Plant: Bloom fuel cells at Chirisa's Volo, Illinois site.

deals.title: AMD buys AI server builder ZT Systems for $4.9B

sources.quote: AMD has agreed to acquire ZT Systems in a cash and stock transaction valued at $4.9 billion, inclusive of a contingent payment of up to $400 million based on certain post-closing milestones.

deals.explain: AMD paid cash and stock for ZT Systems, a New Jersey company that designs and builds rack-scale AI servers for the biggest cloud companies, to help it sell complete AI systems against Nvidia. The $4.9 billion includes up to $400 million that depends on later milestones. The deal closed in March 2025; AMD later sold ZT's factory business to Sanmina.

deals.title: a16z backs SSI's $1B first round

sources.quote: Safe Superintelligence (SSI), the AI startup co-founded by former OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, has raised over $1 billion in capital from investors including NFDG (an investment partnership run by Nat Friedman and SSI CEO Daniel Gross), a16z, Sequoia, DST Global and SV Angel.

deals.explain: Ilya Sutskever's Safe Superintelligence raised just over $1 billion from a16z, Sequoia, DST Global, SV Angel and NFDG. The amount shown is the whole round as reported; a16z's own share was not disclosed.

deals.title: Sequoia backs SSI's first round

sources.quote: Safe Superintelligence (SSI), the AI startup co-founded by former OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, has raised over $1 billion in capital from investors including NFDG (an investment partnership run by Nat Friedman and SSI CEO Daniel Gross), a16z, Sequoia, DST Global and SV Angel.

deals.explain: Sequoia took part in Safe Superintelligence's roughly $1 billion first round (counted in full on the a16z record); its amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia joins $160M private placement in Applied Digital

sources.quote: We’re proud of our strong relationship with NVIDIA, and the confidence that both they and Related Companies, along with institutional investors, have placed in us.

deals.explain: Nvidia was one of several buyers of new Applied Digital shares in a $160 million private placement that also included Related Companies and other investors. Nvidia's own share of the $160 million was not disclosed.

deals.title: AWS and Intel strike multi-billion-dollar custom chip deal

sources.quote: Intel Corp. (INTC) and Amazon Web Services. Inc. (AWS), an Amazon.com company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced a co-investment in custom chip designs under a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar framework covering product and wafers from Intel.

deals.explain: Amazon Web Services agreed to buy custom chips from Intel, including an AI networking chip on Intel's newest 18A process and a custom Xeon 6 server chip, under a multi-year framework the companies called multi-billion-dollar. The exact amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Microsoft signs 20-year PPA to restart Three Mile Island Unit 1 (Crane)

sources.quote: Under the agreement, Microsoft will purchase energy from the renewed plant as part of its goal to help match the power its data centers in PJM use with carbon-free energy.

In September 2024, we executed a 20-year PPA with Microsoft that will support the restart of Three Mile Island Unit 1, renamed as the Crane Clean Energy Center, which was retired in 2019 for economic reasons.

deals.explain: Microsoft agreed to buy all the power from the shut-down Three Mile Island Unit 1 reactor in Pennsylvania for 20 years, which pays for Constellation to restart it (about 835 MW, expected online around 2028). Price not disclosed. Plant: Crane Clean Energy Center (Three Mile Island Unit 1), Pennsylvania.

deals.title: Crusoe builds its cloud storage product on VAST Data

sources.quote: “Crusoe chose the VAST Data Platform because of its exceptional ability to deliver the reliable file storage that our customers need without any depletion of performance as AI models are scaled,” said Patrick McGregor, Crusoe’s Chief Product Officer.

deals.explain: Crusoe, an AI cloud and data center company, launched a storage service for its customers built on VAST Data's platform, making Crusoe a VAST customer. No price was disclosed.

deals.title: MGX joins OpenAI's $6.6B round

sources.quote: The latest funding round also included participation from Khosla Ventures, Altimeter Capital, Fidelity, MGX and Tiger Global, sources told CNBC.

deals.explain: Abu Dhabi's MGX reportedly took part in OpenAI's $6.6 billion October 2024 round (counted in full on the Thrive record); its amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Thrive leads OpenAI's $6.6B round

sources.quote: While OpenAI didn’t name the investors in Wednesday’s press release, a person with knowledge of the matter said the round was led by Thrive Capital and included participation from existing backer Microsoft as well as chipmaker Nvidia, SoftBank and others.

deals.explain: OpenAI raised $6.6 billion at a $157 billion valuation in a round that, according to a person familiar with it, Thrive Capital led. The amount shown is the whole round; CNBC earlier reported Thrive planned to put in about $1 billion.

deals.title: Google signs deal for 500 MW of Kairos Power small reactors by 2035

sources.quote: Alameda, CA – October 14, 2024 – Kairos Power and Google have signed a Master Plant Development Agreement, creating a path to deploy a U.S. fleet of advanced nuclear power projects totaling 500 MW by 2035.

deals.explain: Google agreed to buy power from a fleet of Kairos Power molten-salt reactors totaling 500 MW, with the first by 2030 and the rest by 2035, under power purchase agreements. Prices not disclosed. Plants: future Kairos reactors near Google data centers; the first is Hermes 2 in Oak Ridge, Tennessee.

deals.title: Blue Owl co-funds $3.4B Crusoe data center JV in Abilene

sources.quote: announced today a $3.4 billion joint-venture to fund purpose-built data center capacity at the previously announced Lancium Clean Campus in Abilene, Texas.

deals.explain: Blue Owl's real estate funds and Primary Digital Infrastructure agreed to fund a $3.4 billion joint venture for Crusoe's first 200+ megawatt AI data center buildings in Abilene, Texas. The amount is the whole venture; it was later expanded to $15 billion.

deals.title: Amazon invests in X-energy and targets 5 GW of Xe-100 reactors by 2039

sources.quote: We have three publicly announced customers in (1) Dow, (2) Amazon, both of whom have made an equity investment in X-energy and (3) Centrica.

Amazon and Energy Northwest entered into a Carbon Free Development and Funding Agreement for an initial deployment of four reactors representing 320 MWe, with the potential to upsize the power capacity to 960 MWe.

deals.explain: Amazon became an owner of small-reactor developer X-energy in October 2024, alongside plans for more than 5 GW of Xe-100 reactors by 2039 (first: four reactors with Energy Northwest in Washington). Amazon's exact check was not disclosed; X-energy's prospectus shows a $20M Amazon convertible note plus a warrant later worth about $285M, within a $626.5M 2024 round. Plants: planned Xe-100 units near Richland, Washington (Energy Northwest).

deals.title: Schneider Electric buys 75% of liquid-cooling maker Motivair for $850M

Direct Funding Amount $7.865 billion

deals.title: AWS signs 5-year deal for Marvell custom AI and data-center chips

deals.title: Meta picks Pure Storage flash tech for its next-gen data centers

deals.title: U.S. awards Micron up to $6.165B CHIPS grant

deals.title: Nvidia joins Crusoe's $600M Series D

deals.title: AMD Ventures co-leads Vultr's $333M round

deals.title: Switch signs 12 GW Master Power Agreement with Oklo

deals.title: U.S. awards SK hynix up to $458M CHIPS grant

deals.title: U.S. awards Amkor up to $407M CHIPS grant

deals.explain: The government agreed to give Amkor up to $407 million in grants for an advanced chip packaging and testing plant in Peoria, Arizona, the step that joins AI chips to their memory.

deals.title: U.S. awards Samsung up to $4.745B CHIPS grant

deals.title: BlackRock invests in xAI's Series C

deals.title: Constellation buys Calpine for $16.4B equity ($26.6B net)

sources.quote: This acquisition doubles NRG's generation capacity with the addition of 18 natural gas-fired facilities totaling approximately 13 GW.

HOUSTON-January 30, 2026-NRG Energy, Inc. (NYSE: NRG) today announced that it has completed the acquisition of a portfolio of generation assets and CPower from LS Power.

deals.explain: NRG bought about 13 GW of natural-gas power plants and the CPower demand-response business from LS Power for $6.4 billion in cash plus 24.25 million NRG shares; NRG's May 12, 2025 release values the deal at about $12.0 billion including $3.2 billion of assumed debt, doubling its fleet to ~25 GW to serve rising demand including data centers. deals.title: Humain and AMD plan 500 MW of AMD-based AI compute

sources.quote: As part of the agreement, the parties will invest up to $10B to deploy 500 megawatts of AI compute capacity over the next five years.

deals.explain: Humain will build AI data centers using AMD chips and software, 500 megawatts over five years. The headline $10B is what both companies together plan to invest, not a price Humain pays AMD, so the amount is shown as undisclosed.

deals.title: Humain buys 18,000 Nvidia GB300 chips for Saudi AI factories

sources.quote: The first phase of deployment will be an 18,000 NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell AI supercomputer with NVIDIA InfiniBand networking.

HUMAIN is making a major investment to build AI factories in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with a projected capacity of up to 500 megawatts powered by several hundred thousand of NVIDIA's most advanced GPUs over the next five years.

deals.explain: Humain, the AI company owned by Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund, is buying Nvidia chips for data centers of up to 500 megawatts, starting with 18,000 top-end GB300 chips. No price was given.

deals.title: AMD Ventures co-leads TensorWave's $100M Series A

sources.quote: Magnetar and AMD Ventures led the round, with continued support from Maverick Silicon, Nexus Venture Partners, and new investor Prosperity7.

deals.explain: AMD's venture arm co-led a $100 million round in TensorWave, a cloud built entirely on AMD GPUs. AMD's own share was not disclosed.

deals.title: OpenAI adds up to $4B more CoreWeave capacity

sources.quote: As of May 14, 2025, subject to the satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to $4.0 billion through April 2029 related to this agreement.
In March 2025, CoreWeave announced an initial agreement with OpenAI with a contract value up to $11.9 billion, followed by an expanded agreement worth up to $4 billion in May 2025.

deals.explain: A second OpenAI order with CoreWeave: up to $4 billion more of rented AI computing through April 2029, on top of the March 2025 deal.

deals.title: Blue Owl JV with Crusoe grows to $15B for Abilene campus

sources.quote: Crusoe, a vertically-integrated AI infrastructure company, Blue Owl Capital Inc. (“Blue Owl”), a leading alternative asset manager, and Primary Digital Infrastructure, an advisory and data center investment platform, announced today the second phase of a $15 billion joint-venture to fund the 1.2 gigawatt AI data center in Abilene, Texas.

deals.explain: Crusoe, Blue Owl's funds and Primary Digital Infrastructure expanded their Abilene, Texas joint venture to $15 billion to fund a 1.2 gigawatt AI campus. The amount is the whole venture, including Crusoe's and Primary Digital's parts; Blue Owl's own share was not disclosed.

deals.title: Oracle reportedly to spend ~$40B on Nvidia chips for Stargate Abilene

sources.quote: According to the FT report, and citing people "familiar with the matter," Oracle will purchase around 400,000 of Nvidia's GB200s to lease to OpenAI.
Oracle is planning to spend about $40 billion on high-performance Nvidia computer chips to power its new giant OpenAI data center in the United States, the Financial Times reports.

deals.explain: The Financial Times reported that Oracle would buy about 400,000 Nvidia GB200 chips, roughly $40B, for the Stargate data center in Abilene, Texas, and rent the computing power to OpenAI. Neither company confirmed the number.

deals.title: CoreWeave leases 250 MW at Applied Digital's North Dakota campus (~$7B)

sources.quote: Over the approximately 15-year term, Applied Digital anticipates generating approximately $7 billion in total revenue from the leases.

deals.explain: CoreWeave, an AI cloud company, signed two roughly 15-year leases to rent 250 megawatts of data center space at Applied Digital's Ellendale, North Dakota campus (later named Polaris Forge 1). Applied Digital expects about $7 billion in rent over the term.

deals.title: Meta signs 20-year PPA for Constellation's Clinton nuclear plant

sources.quote: Constellation (Nasdaq: CEG) and Meta have signed a 20-year power purchase agreement (PPA) for the output of the Clinton Clean Energy Center to support Meta’s clean energy goals and operations in the region with 1,121 megawatts of emissions-free nuclear energy.

Clinton Clean Energy Center In June 2025, we signed a 20-year PPA with Meta Platforms, Inc. (Meta) for the output of the Clinton Clean Energy Center to support Meta’s clean energy goals and operations in the region with emissions-free nuclear energy.

deals.explain: Meta will buy the full 1,121 MW output of the Clinton nuclear plant in Illinois for 20 years starting June 2027, when a state subsidy ends, keeping the plant running and adding 30 MW via upgrades. Price not disclosed. Plant: Clinton Clean Energy Center (Clinton Power Station), Illinois.

deals.title: Qualcomm buys Alphawave for $2.3B

sources.quote: On December 18, 2025 (the Closing Date), we completed the acquisition of Alphawave IP Group plc (Alphawave) for $2.3 billion, which primarily consisted of $1.8 billion of equity consideration from the issuance of 11 million shares of our common stock, which includes certain securities exchangeable for shares of our common stock (Exchangeable Shares), and $301 million of cash consideration.

deals.explain: Qualcomm bought UK-listed Alphawave, which designs high-speed data connection technology and custom chips for data centers, to support Qualcomm's move into AI data-center chips. Agreed in June 2025, closed December 2025.

deals.title: Nebius selects WEKA storage software for its premium AI cloud tier

sources.quote: To fuel the premium tier of its next-generation platform, Nebius selected WEKA's high-performance storage software to turbocharge its AI Cloud performance while effortlessly scaling from petabytes to exabytes of data.

deals.explain: Nebius chose WEKA's storage software for the top tier of its AI cloud, so Nebius pays WEKA to keep its GPUs fed with data. No price was disclosed.

deals.title: OpenAI adds Google Cloud as a computing supplier

sources.quote: The ChatGPT developer has finalized a deal to utilize Alphabet's (GOOGL) Google cloud services to meet its increasing need for computing capacity, Reuters reported.
As reported by Reuters, OpenAI finalized a deal last month to begin tapping Google Cloud's powerful infrastructure, including its custom TPU chips.

deals.explain: OpenAI reportedly agreed in May 2025 to rent extra computing from Google Cloud, a rival, to keep up with demand for ChatGPT. The deal was reported by Reuters from anonymous sources; no amount was disclosed.

deals.title: Amazon expands Talen nuclear PPA to 1,920 MW through 2042

sources.quote: Under the expanded PPA, at the full contract quantity, Talen will provide Amazon with 1,920 megawatts of carbon-free nuclear power through 2042, with options to further extend its duration.

deals.explain: Talen will sell Amazon up to 1,920 MW of power from the Susquehanna nuclear plant in Pennsylvania through 2042, delivered over the PJM grid instead of directly behind the meter. The companies did not state a dollar value (trade press cited an ~$18B Talen investor estimate, not used here). Plant: Susquehanna Steam Electric Station, Pennsylvania.

deals.title: Micron HBM3E designed into AMD's Instinct MI350 AI chips

sources.quote: Micron announces the integration of our HBM3E 36GB 12-high offering into AMD's upcoming Instinct™ MI350X Series GPUs and platform.

deals.explain: AMD uses Micron's 12-layer HBM3E high-bandwidth memory in its MI350 AI accelerators, making AMD a Micron memory customer. The value was not disclosed.

deals.title: Crusoe to buy about $400M of AMD MI355X chips

sources.quote: Cherney SAN FRANCISCO (Reuters) -Crusoe CEO Chase Lochmiller said on Thursday the artificial intelligence data center builder planned to purchase roughly $400 million worth of AI chips from Advanced Micro Devices to add to its portfolio of computing power.

deals.explain: Crusoe, which rents AI computing to customers, said it planned to buy about $400M of AMD's MI355X chips (roughly 13,000) for a new US data center. The figure came from Crusoe's CEO in a Reuters interview, not a filing.

deals.title: Meta invests $14.3B for 49% of Scale AI

sources.quote: Meta is pumping $14.3 billion into Scale AI as part of the deal, and will have a 49% stake in the artificial intelligence startup, but will not have any voting power, a Scale AI spokesperson said.
In June 2025, we completed an investment in Scale AI by acquiring a non-voting minority of its outstanding equity.

In addition, Scale will distribute proceeds from Meta’s investment to Scale shareholders and vested equity holders, providing them with substantial liquidity as well as the opportunity to continue participating in Scale’s success as ongoing equity holders of the Company.

deals.explain: Meta paid $14.3 billion for a 49% non-voting stake in Scale AI, which labels data used to train AI models, and hired Scale's founder Alexandr Wang to lead its AI push. Most of the money went out to Scale's existing shareholders.

deals.title: U.S. adds up to $275M CHIPS grant for Micron

sources.quote: Today’s expanded investment of $200 billion is accompanied by up to $275 million in incremental CHIPS Act direct funding.

deals.explain: When Micron raised its U.S. investment plan to $200 billion in June 2025, the Commerce Department added up to $275 million in grants on top of its December 2024 award, tied to Micron's Manassas, Virginia plant.

deals.title: xAI uses Oracle cloud to train and run next Grok models

sources.quote: xAI will also leverage the scalability, performance, and cost efficiency of OCI’s leading AI infrastructure to train and run inferencing for its next-generation Grok models.

deals.explain: Elon Musk's xAI said it would rent Oracle's cloud to train and run its Grok models, while Oracle also resells Grok to its business customers. No dollar amount was disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia's NVentures joins TerraPower's $650M fundraise

sources.quote: This fundraise was comprised of both new investors, including NVentures, the venture capital arm of NVIDIA, and current investors, including TerraPower-founder Bill Gates and HD Hyundai, an industry leader in shipbuilding.

deals.explain: Nvidia's venture arm invested in Bill Gates-founded TerraPower as part of a $650 million round to build its first Natrium reactor in Kemmerer, Wyoming. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Google signs 200 MW fusion PPA for CFS's first ARC plant

sources.quote: Google signed a power purchase agreement (PPA) for 200 megawatts (MW) of electricity from CFS’ inaugural ARC power plant, which CFS expects will put power on the grid in the early 2030s, in Chesterfield County, Virginia.

deals.explain: Google agreed to buy 200 MW, about half the output, of Commonwealth Fusion Systems' first ARC fusion power plant in Chesterfield County, Virginia, expected in the early 2030s, with options on future plants. Price not disclosed. Plant: CFS ARC fusion plant, Chesterfield County, Virginia (planned).

deals.title: Google increases its equity stake in Commonwealth Fusion Systems

sources.quote: An investor in CFS since 2021, Google also is deepening its relationship with CFS by increasing its stake in the company.

This effort to put power on the grid in the early 2030s is bolstered by strategic partnerships with Dominion Energy and Google — an investor in CFS that also agreed to buy half the power produced at the plant.

deals.explain: Alongside its 200 MW fusion power deal, Google (an investor since 2021) put more money into Commonwealth Fusion Systems, and took part in CFS's $863 million Series B2 round in August 2025. Google's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: CoreWeave's ~$9B all-stock bid for Core Scientific (voted down)

sources.quote: As of July 3, 2025, the agreed-upon exchange ratio implies a total equity value of approximately $9.0 billion.
On October 30, 2025, pursuant to and in accordance with the merger agreement, Core Scientific terminated the merger agreement with CoreWeave, effective immediately.

deals.explain: CoreWeave agreed to buy its landlord Core Scientific with its own shares, valued at about $9 billion. Core Scientific shareholders voted it down in October 2025 and the deal was terminated, so no money changed hands.

deals.title: AMD joins Thinking Machines' $2B seed round

deals.title: a16z leads Thinking Machines Lab's $2B seed round

deals.explain: Andreessen Horowitz led a $2 billion first funding round for Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab at a $12 billion valuation, with Nvidia, AMD, Cisco and others joining. The amount shown is the whole round; a16z's own share was not disclosed.

deals.title: Cisco joins Thinking Machines' $2B seed round

deals.title: Nvidia joins Thinking Machines' $2B seed round

sources.quote: The deal, which includes participation from Nvidia, Accel, ServiceNow, CISCO, AMD, and Jane Street, values the startup at $12 billion, the spokesperson said.

deals.explain: Nvidia invested an undisclosed amount in the record $2 billion seed round of Thinking Machines Lab, the AI startup founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, which valued it at $12 billion.

deals.title: Google signs $3B+ hydro PPAs with Brookfield under 3 GW framework

sources.quote: The first contracts executed under the HFA are for Brookfield’s Holtwood and Safe Harbor hydroelectric facilities in Pennsylvania, representing more than $3 billion of power and 670 MW of capacity.

Under the HFA, Google has the ability to procure carbon-free electricity from up to 3,000 MWs of hydroelectric assets that will be relicensed, overhauled, or upgraded to extend the asset’s useful life and continue adding power to the grid.

deals.explain: Google signed 20-year power purchase agreements worth more than $3 billion for 670 MW from two Brookfield hydro dams in Pennsylvania, the first deals under a framework for up to 3,000 MW of hydro. The amount is a floor ('more than $3 billion'). Plants: Holtwood Hydroelectric Station and Safe Harbor Dam, Pennsylvania.

deals.title: Vertiv buys data center rack maker Great Lakes for $200M

today announced the successful completion of its previously reported intent to acquire the Great Lakes Data Racks & Cabinets family of companies

deals.explain: Vertiv paid $200 million for Great Lakes, a Pennsylvania maker of the metal racks and cabinets that hold servers in data centers, including racks built for dense AI hardware. The deal closed in August 2025.

deals.title: Crusoe orders 29 GE Vernova gas turbines for AI data centers

sources.quote: GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE: GEV) and Crusoe, the industry’s first vertically integrated AI infrastructure provider, today announced a significant deal to deliver 29 units of GE Vernova’s breakthrough LM2500XPRESS aeroderivative gas turbine packages to Crusoe AI data centers.

deals.explain: AI cloud company Crusoe ordered 29 truck-sized gas turbines (about 35 megawatts each, nearly 1 gigawatt in total) from GE Vernova to generate its own power on site at AI data centers. 10 units were ordered in December 2024 and 19 more in June 2025. The price was not disclosed.

deals.title: Tesla signs $16.5B chip-making contract with Samsung

sources.quote: Samsung Electronics has entered into a $16.5 billion contract for supplying semiconductors to Tesla, based on a regulatory filing by the South Korean firm and Tesla CEO Elon Musk’s posts on X.

deals.explain: Tesla will pay Samsung to manufacture its next-generation AI chips (AI6) at Samsung's new factory in Taylor, Texas. Samsung disclosed a contract worth about $16.5 billion running from July 2025 to the end of 2033 without naming the buyer; Elon Musk confirmed Tesla was the customer and said the real figure could be higher.

deals.title: Amphenol buys CommScope's fiber connectivity business for $10.5B

sources.quote: Amphenol Corporation (NYSE: APH) today announced a definitive agreement to acquire CommScope's (NASDAQ: COMM) Connectivity and Cable Solutions (CCS) business for $10.5 billion in cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments.
to disclose that it had completed its acquisition of the Connectivity and Cable Solutions business (which we now refer to collectively as “CommScope”) of Vistance Networks, Inc.

deals.explain: Connector maker Amphenol paid $10.5 billion in cash for CommScope's Connectivity and Cable Solutions unit, which makes fiber optic cables and connectors used inside data centers. The money went to CommScope (now renamed Vistance Networks). The deal closed in January 2026.

deals.title: Apple commits $2.5B to Corning's Kentucky glass plant

deals.explain: Apple committed $2.5 billion so Corning's Kentucky plant makes all iPhone and Apple Watch cover glass. This is phone glass, not data center gear, but it is one of Corning's largest single customer commitments and part of Apple's $600 billion US investment pledge.

deals.title: Apple signs chipmaking agreement with GlobalFoundries in New York

deals.title: Fluidstack signs 10-year, 200+ MW leases at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner (~$3.7B)

deals.title: CoreWeave signs Helios Phase II lease with Galaxy (260 MW)

deals.title: CoreWeave takes final 133 MW at Galaxy's Helios (Phase III)

deals.explain: CoreWeave exercised its last option at Helios in August 2025 and signed the Phase III lease in January 2026, committing to all 800 MW of approved power there (526 MW of IT load). deals.title: Fluidstack adds 160 MW CB-5 lease at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner (~$3.0B)

deals.title: Google to get Hermes 2 nuclear clean energy attributes through TVA

deals.title: SoftBank buys $2B of Intel stock

sources.quote: SoftBank Group Corp. (TOKYO: 9984, “SoftBank”) and Intel Corporation (Nasdaq: INTC) today announced their signing of a definitive securities purchase agreement, under which SoftBank will make a $2 billion investment in Intel common stock.

On August 18, 2025, we entered into an agreement to issue and sell 87 million shares of our common stock to SoftBank Group at $23.00 per share, representing an aggregate cash purchase price of $2.0 billion.

deals.explain: SoftBank bought 87 million new Intel shares at $23 each, giving Intel $2 billion in cash to help fund its chip factories. The sale closed in September 2025.

deals.title: TVA signs PPA for up to 50 MW from Kairos Power's Hermes 2 reactor

sources.quote: Through a new power purchase agreement (PPA) between Kairos Power and TVA, Kairos Power’s Hermes 2 Plant in Oak Ridge, Tenn., will deliver up to 50 megawatts (MW) of reliable, 24/7 energy to the TVA grid that powers Google data centers in Tennessee and Alabama.

deals.explain: The Tennessee Valley Authority will buy up to 50 MW from Kairos Power's Hermes 2 advanced reactor in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, starting around 2030; it is the first U.S. utility deal to buy power from a Gen IV reactor. deals.title: Entergy Louisiana to build 2.3 GW of gas plants to serve Meta's Hyperion

deals.title: Meta signs six-year Google Cloud deal reported at more than $10B

Meta has made a cloud computing deal with Google worth more than US$10 billion over the course of six years, a source close to the transaction told AFP Thursday.

deals.explain: Meta agreed to rent servers, storage and networking from Google Cloud for six years, a deal sources put at more than $10 billion. It was Meta's first big cloud deal with Google; neither company published the terms.

deals.title: U.S. government takes $8.9B equity stake in Intel

deals.title: Nvidia's NVentures joins CFS's $863M Series B2 fusion round

deals.title: CoreWeave adds 150 MW lease at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 (~$4B)

sources.quote: This new lease agreement with CoreWeave brings Applied Digital’s total anticipated contracted lease revenue to approximately $11B, which includes $7B in revenue from the initial two approximately 15-year leases executed in May of this year.

deals.title: Fidelity co-leads Anthropic's Series F

sources.quote: Along with ICONIQ, the round was co-led by Fidelity Management & Research Company and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

deals.explain: Lightspeed co-led Anthropic's $13 billion Series F (counted in full on the ICONIQ record). Lightspeed's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Anthropic's $10B order for Google TPU racks from Broadcom

deals.title: Microsoft signs $17.4B GPU capacity deal with Nebius

deals.title: Nvidia to rent back its GPUs from Lambda for ~$1.5B
