deals.explain: Chip-equipment maker ASML put €1.3 billion (about $1.52 billion at roughly $1.17 per euro in September 2025) into Mistral AI for about 11% of the company. The two plan to use Mistral's AI inside ASML's machines and processes.

deals.title: Nvidia agrees to buy CoreWeave's unsold capacity, $6.3B initial value

sources.quote: Under the terms of agreement, in instances where the Company’s datacenter capacity is not fully utilized by its own customers, NVIDIA is obligated to purchase the residual unsold capacity through April 13, 2032, subject to any termination described below and satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements.
In addition to the MSA, NVIDIA supplies the Company with NVIDIA GPUs and is a stockholder of the Company.

deals.explain: Nvidia agreed to buy any CoreWeave computing capacity that CoreWeave's own customers don't use, through April 2032; the order has an initial value of $6.3 billion. Nvidia pays only for leftover capacity, so the real amount could be lower. Nvidia also sells CoreWeave its GPUs and owns CoreWeave shares, so money flows both ways.

deals.title: Nvidia joins Mistral's Series C

sources.quote: It includes participation from existing investors: DST Global, Andreessen Horowitz, Bpifrance, General Catalyst, Index Ventures, Lightspeed and NVIDIA.

deals.explain: Nvidia, already a Mistral shareholder, put an undisclosed amount into Mistral's €1.7 billion Series C round led by ASML.

deals.title: OpenAI reportedly to buy about $300B of Oracle cloud computing over five years

sources.quote: OpenAI signed a $300 billion contract with Oracle to purchase cloud computing capacity over five years, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
OpenAI has committed to a $300bn cloud computing contract with Oracle, expected to last nearly five years, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal citing undisclosed sources.

Our MultiCloud database revenue continues to grow at over 100%, and we signed multiple large cloud services agreements including one that is expected to contribute more than $30 billion in annual revenue starting in FY28.
Multiple news outlets have confirmed that the eye-popping, $30 billion-a-year contract that Oracle revealed earlier this week is with artificial intelligence company OpenAI.

deals.explain: OpenAI is renting about 4.5 gigawatts of data-center computing from Oracle as part of its Stargate build-out. Oracle disclosed an unnamed $30B-a-year contract in June 2025 that reporters tied to OpenAI; the Wall Street Journal put the total at about $300B over roughly five years starting in 2027. Neither company has confirmed the total.

deals.title: Nvidia backs Firmus's A$330M raise

sources.quote: Source: Firmus Firmus Technologies has become the latest Australian-founded startup to reach unicorn status, after the artificial intelligence infrastructure company raised $330 million in a round backed by US chip giant Nvidia.

The round marks a steep climb for Firmus, which closed an A$330 million (approximately US$215 million) equity raise in September 2025 led by Ellerston Capital with participation from Nvidia, valuing the company at A$1.85 billion at the time.

deals.explain: Nvidia took part in Firmus's A$330 million (about US$215 million) round to build an AI data center in Tasmania. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Intel Capital invests in Figure's $1B+ Series C

sources.quote: The round was led by Parkway Venture Capital with significant investment from Brookfield Asset Management, NVIDIA, Macquarie Capital, Intel Capital, Align Ventures, Tamarack Global, LG Technology Ventures, Salesforce, T-Mobile Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures.

deals.explain: Intel Capital put an undisclosed amount into humanoid-robot maker Figure's Series C, which raised more than $1 billion at a $39 billion valuation.

deals.title: Nvidia invests in Figure's $1B+ Series C

sources.quote: The round was led by Parkway Venture Capital with significant investment from Brookfield Asset Management, NVIDIA, Macquarie Capital, Intel Capital, Align Ventures, Tamarack Global, LG Technology Ventures, Salesforce, T-Mobile Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures.

deals.explain: Nvidia put an undisclosed amount into humanoid-robot maker Figure's Series C, which raised more than $1 billion at a $39 billion valuation.

deals.title: Qualcomm Ventures invests in Figure's $1B+ Series C

sources.quote: The round was led by Parkway Venture Capital with significant investment from Brookfield Asset Management, NVIDIA, Macquarie Capital, Intel Capital, Align Ventures, Tamarack Global, LG Technology Ventures, Salesforce, T-Mobile Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures.

deals.explain: Qualcomm Ventures put an undisclosed amount into humanoid-robot maker Figure's Series C, which raised more than $1 billion at a $39 billion valuation.

deals.title: Nvidia reportedly pays $900M+ to license Enfabrica tech and hire its CEO

sources.quote: According to a CNBC report on Thursday, Nvidia spent more than $900 million in cash and stock to hire Rochan Sankar, the CEO of AI chip startup Enfabrica, as well as several other employees at the company.

deals.explain: Nvidia reportedly paid more than $900M in cash and stock to hire Enfabrica's CEO and engineers and license its technology for linking huge numbers of AI chips together. The companies did not confirm the figure.

deals.title: Nvidia invests $5B in Intel common stock

sources.quote: NVIDIA will invest $5 billion in Intel’s common stock at a purchase price of $23.28 per share.

On September 15, 2025, we entered into an agreement to issue and sell 215 million shares of our common stock to NVIDIA at a price of $23.28 per share, representing an aggregate cash purchase price of $5.0 billion.

deals.explain: Nvidia bought $5 billion of newly issued Intel shares (about 215 million shares at $23.28), giving cash-strapped Intel fresh capital. The two also agreed to co-develop data center and PC chips that link Intel CPUs with Nvidia technology. The purchase closed on December 26, 2025.

deals.title: Ciena buys AI interconnect startup Nubis for $270M

sources.quote: Under the terms of the agreement, Ciena will acquire Nubis in an all-cash transaction for $270 million, subject to a customary purchase price adjustment mechanism for the amount of cash, debt, and net working capital of Nubis at closing, among other items.
On October 7, 2025, Ciena Corporation completed its acquisition of privately-held Nubis Communications, Inc.

deals.explain: Optical networking company Ciena paid $270 million in cash for Nubis, a New Jersey startup making compact, low-power optical and electrical links that connect AI chips. The deal closed in October 2025.

deals.title: Nvidia to invest up to $100B in OpenAI (letter of intent)

sources.quote: To support the partnership, NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI progressively as each gigawatt is deployed.
In the third quarter of fiscal year 2026, we entered into a letter of intent with an opportunity to invest in OpenAI.

deals.explain: Nvidia signed a non-binding letter of intent to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI, step by step as OpenAI deployed 10 gigawatts of Nvidia systems. It was never turned into a final contract; in February 2026 it was replaced by a $30 billion equity investment.

deals.title: OpenAI plans to deploy at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems

sources.quote: OpenAI and NVIDIA today announced a letter of intent for a landmark strategic partnership to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI's next-generation AI infrastructure to train and run its next generation of models on the path to deploying superintelligence.

deals.explain: OpenAI signed a letter of intent (a non-binding plan) to use at least 10 gigawatts of Nvidia computers, with the first gigawatt due in the second half of 2026. No price was given; Nvidia separately said it intends to invest up to $100B in OpenAI as the systems are deployed, so money flows both ways.

deals.title: Dell joins Nscale's $1.1B Series B

sources.quote: The financing was led by Aker ASA, with continued support from existing shareholders, including Sandton Capital, and participation from Blue Owl Managed Funds, Dell, Fidelity Management & Research Company, G Squared, Nokia, NVIDIA, Point72 and T.Capital.

deals.explain: Server maker Dell invested an undisclosed amount in Nscale's $1.1 billion Series B. Dell sells AI servers to neoclouds like Nscale, so it is backing a customer.

deals.title: Fluidstack signs 10-year, 168 MW lease at Cipher's Barber Lake (~$3B)

sources.quote: The agreement represents approximately $3 billion in contracted revenue over the initial 10-year term and includes two five-year extension options.

deals.explain: Fluidstack will rent 168 megawatts at Cipher's Barber Lake site in Texas for 10 years, worth about $3 billion. Google backstops $1.4 billion of Fluidstack's obligations and got warrants for about 5.4% of Cipher.

deals.title: Meta commits up to $14.2B for CoreWeave AI cloud

sources.quote: Subject to any termination described below and satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, Meta has initially committed to pay the Company up to approximately $14.2 billion through December 14, 2031 under the Order Form, with the option to materially expand its commitment through 2032 for additional cloud computing capacity under the Order Form.

deals.explain: Meta agreed to pay CoreWeave up to about $14.2 billion through December 2031 to rent AI computing capacity, with an option to buy more. It made Meta one of CoreWeave's largest customers alongside Microsoft and OpenAI.

deals.title: Nokia joins Nscale's $1.1B Series B

sources.quote: The financing was led by Aker ASA, with continued support from existing shareholders, including Sandton Capital, and participation from Blue Owl Managed Funds, Dell, Fidelity Management & Research Company, G Squared, Nokia, NVIDIA, Point72 and T.Capital.

deals.explain: Networking gear maker Nokia invested an undisclosed amount in Nscale's $1.1 billion Series B.

deals.title: Nvidia joins Nscale's $1.1B Series B

sources.quote: The financing was led by Aker ASA, with continued support from existing shareholders, including Sandton Capital, and participation from Blue Owl Managed Funds, Dell, Fidelity Management & Research Company, G Squared, Nokia, NVIDIA, Point72 and T.Capital.

deals.explain: Nvidia invested an undisclosed amount in Nscale's $1.1 billion Series B, then the largest Series B in European history. Nscale fills its data centers with Nvidia GPUs.

deals.title: OpenAI expands CoreWeave deal by up to $6.5B

sources.quote: Subject to any termination described below and satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, OpenAI has committed to pay the Company up to approximately $6.5 billion through May 31, 2031 under the Order Form.
The agreement announced today brings the total contract value with OpenAI up to approximately $22.4 billion.

deals.explain: A third OpenAI order with CoreWeave worth up to $6.5 billion through May 2031, bringing OpenAI's total CoreWeave commitments to about $22.4 billion.

deals.title: Meta to acquire RISC-V chip startup Rivos

sources.quote: Meta Platforms is set to acquire Rivos, a Santa Clara-based chip startup specializing in RISC-V architecture, Reuters reported, citing a source familiar with the matter.

deals.explain: Meta agreed to buy Rivos, a startup designing chips on the open RISC-V standard, to speed up its in-house AI chip program and rely less on Nvidia. Terms were not disclosed.

deals.title: Crusoe's 1.2 GW Abilene campus built for Oracle (Stargate)

sources.quote: Share: ABILENE, TX — September 30, 2025 — Crusoe, the industry’s first vertically integrated AI infrastructure provider, today announced that the first phase of Stargate’s flagship data center campus in Abilene, Texas, is now up and running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and continues to progress rapidly.
At its flagship 1.2 GW Abilene, Texas campus – purpose built for Oracle - the first two buildings are operational and an additional six buildings are under construction.

deals.explain: Crusoe designed and built the 1.2-gigawatt Abilene, Texas campus for Oracle, which uses it to serve OpenAI under the Stargate project. Terms were not disclosed, and the campus is financed through a joint venture of Crusoe, Blue Owl and Primary Digital, so Oracle's payments go to that venture rather than to Crusoe alone.

deals.title: OpenAI signs letter of intent for Samsung memory chips for Stargate

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, Samsung Electronics will work with OpenAI as a strategic memory supplier for its Stargate initiative, aimed at building next-generation AI infrastructure.

OpenAI and several Samsung affiliates have signed a letter of intent (LOI) to work together on developing global AI data center infrastructure and advancing technologies that are essential for AI model training and inference.

deals.explain: OpenAI and Samsung signed a non-binding letter of intent under which Samsung would supply memory chips for OpenAI's Stargate data centers, whose demand OpenAI projects at up to 900,000 DRAM wafers a month. No price or volume commitment was announced, so the money involved is unknown.

deals.title: OpenAI signs letter of intent for SK hynix HBM memory for Stargate

sources.quote: SK hynix signed a Letter of Intent (LOI) with OpenAI to supply High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), for the construction of global AI data centers under the Stargate project.
SK hynix will establish a production system capable of promptly meeting OpenAI’s HBM demand for up to 900,000 DRAM wafers per month.

deals.explain: OpenAI signed a non-binding letter of intent for SK hynix to supply high-bandwidth memory (the fast memory stacked next to AI chips) for its Stargate data centers. SK said OpenAI's demand could reach up to 900,000 DRAM wafers a month, but no price was given.

deals.title: xAI reportedly to spend $18B+ on Nvidia GPUs for Colossus 2

sources.quote: The purchase is expected to set back the company at least $18 billion, a sum that doesn’t include related equipment such as servers.

deals.explain: The Wall Street Journal reported that xAI would buy about 300,000 Nvidia AI chips for its Colossus 2 data center in Memphis, costing at least $18B. The figure comes from an unnamed source; reports said the chips would be bought through a financing vehicle that leases them to xAI.

deals.title: OpenAI to deploy 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs

sources.quote: OpenAI to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs based on a multi-year, multi-generation agreement
“Our partnership with OpenAI is expected to deliver tens of billions of dollars in revenue for AMD while accelerating OpenAI’s AI infrastructure buildout,” said Jean Hu, EVP, CFO and treasurer, AMD.

deals.explain: OpenAI agreed to buy AMD's Instinct AI chips over several years, enough to use 6 gigawatts of power, starting with 1 gigawatt in late 2026. AMD gave no exact price but said it expects 'tens of billions of dollars' of revenue. AMD also gave OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million AMD shares that vests as purchases grow.

deals.title: Fermi America secures firm gas supply from Energy Transfer for Project Matador

sources.quote: Natural Gas Supply and Fuel Infrastructure On October 9, 2025, we announced that we secured firm natural gas supply arrangements with Energy Transfer intended to support Phase 1 operations.

deals.explain: Fermi America, which is building the 'Project Matador' private power-and-data-center campus near Amarillo, Texas, arranged firm natural gas supply from Energy Transfer for its first phase of gas-fired generation. Volumes and price not disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia leads Reflection AI's $2B round

sources.quote: The funding was led by Nvidia and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
This investment has propelled the company’s valuation to a striking $8 billion.

deals.explain: Nvidia led a $2 billion round in Reflection AI, a US lab building open-weight AI models, valuing it at $8 billion. Nvidia's own share of the round was not disclosed.

deals.title: Brookfield sets up to $5B to fund Bloom fuel cells for AI

sources.quote: In August 2025, Bloom Energy concluded a transaction with Brookfield Asset Management (“Brookfield”) for a prospective financing framework structure (the “Financing Structure”) of up to $5.0 billion over five years for future Bloom Energy fuel cell projects that meet certain investment criteria and contractual criteria or are otherwise approved by Brookfield.

deals.explain: Brookfield agreed to provide up to $5 billion over five years to pay for Bloom Energy fuel-cell power systems at sites such as AI data centers, which Bloom then installs. Money flows only as qualifying projects are approved.

deals.title: OpenAI and Broadcom to deploy 10 GW of OpenAI-designed accelerators

sources.quote: OpenAI and Broadcom announce strategic collaboration to deploy 10 gigawatts of OpenAI-designed AI accelerators
The two companies have signed a term sheet to deploy racks incorporating the AI accelerators and Broadcom networking solutions.

deals.explain: OpenAI designs its own AI chips and Broadcom builds and delivers them in full server racks with Broadcom networking, 10 gigawatts' worth from late 2026 through 2029. The deal is a signed term sheet and no price was disclosed.

deals.title: Oracle to deploy 50,000 AMD MI450 GPUs from 2026

sources.quote: Building on years of co-innovation, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) will be a launch partner for the first publicly available AI supercluster powered by AMD Instinct™ MI450 Series GPUs—with an initial deployment of 50,000 GPUs starting in calendar Q3 2026 and expanding in 2027 and beyond.

deals.explain: Oracle's cloud will buy and install 50,000 of AMD's next-generation MI450 AI chips starting in the third quarter of 2026, to rent out to customers. The price was not disclosed.

deals.title: BlackRock's GIP and AIP buy Aligned Data Centers for $40B

sources.quote: October 16, 2025 at 2:57 PM GMT+8 Log in to save A newly formed consortium comprising the Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Partnership (AIP), MGX, and BlackRock’s Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP) has announced the acquisition of Aligned Data Centers in a transaction valued at US$ 40 billion.
The transaction values Aligned at an enterprise value of approximately US$ 40 billion, making it one of the largest private transactions in the digital infrastructure sector.

deals.explain: A group made up of BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners, the BlackRock-founded AI Infrastructure Partnership (with Microsoft, Nvidia and MGX) and MGX bought data center builder Aligned for about $40 billion including debt. The full price is shown here once; the deal closed in July 2026.

deals.title: MGX co-buys Aligned Data Centers

sources.quote: July 23, 2026 at 3:11 PM GMT+8 Log in to save A consortium led by the Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Partnership (AIP), Abu Dhabi investment firm MGX, and BlackRock’s Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP) has officially completed its acquisition of Aligned Data Centers from infrastructure funds managed by Macquarie Asset Management and its co-investors.

deals.explain: Abu Dhabi's MGX was one of the buyers of Aligned Data Centers in the roughly $40 billion deal (counted in full on the BlackRock record); MGX's share was not disclosed.

deals.title: Microsoft signs four-country AI infrastructure contract with Nscale

sources.quote: Nscale is an ideal partner for this mission, given its deep expertise in providing AI infrastructure services at scale.”Nscale will deliver approximately 104,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs in a ~240MW hyperscale AI campus in Texas, supporting the phased delivery of NVIDIA AI infrastructure services to Microsoft from Q3 2026.

deals.explain: Microsoft contracted Nscale to deliver Nvidia GB300 GPU capacity across Texas, Portugal, the UK and Norway, including about 104,000 GPUs in Texas. The contract value was not disclosed.

deals.title: Energy Department guarantees $1.6B AEP transmission loan

sources.quote: AEP Transmission, a subsidiary of American Electric Power (Nasdaq: AEP) has closed on a $1.6 billion loan guarantee at a preferred interest rate from the U.S.

deals.explain: The Energy Department guaranteed a $1.6 billion loan to AEP's transmission business to rebuild about 5,000 miles of power lines in five states, lowering AEP's borrowing cost as data centers drive up electricity demand.

deals.title: Blue Owl funds take 80% of Meta's ~$27B Hyperion data center

sources.quote: The funds managed by Blue Owl Capital made a cash contribution of approximately $7 billion to the joint venture, and Meta received a one-time distribution from the joint venture in the amount of approximately $3 billion.

The parties have committed to fund their respective pro rata share of the approximately $27 billion in total development costs for the buildings and long-lived power, cooling, and connectivity infrastructure at the campus.

deals.explain: Blue Owl's funds own 80% of a joint venture building Meta's Hyperion AI campus in Louisiana; Meta keeps 20% and leases all the buildings from the venture. Blue Owl put in about $7 billion of cash up front (shown here) and agreed to fund its 80% share of roughly $27 billion in total costs, partly with bonds sold to PIMCO and others.

deals.title: Oracle and OpenAI pick Vantage's Wisconsin 'Lighthouse' campus for Stargate

sources.quote: OpenAI, Oracle and Vantage Data Centers, a leading global provider of hyperscale data center campuses, today announced plans to develop a data center campus outside Milwaukee in Port Washington, Wisconsin.

deals.explain: Vantage is building a roughly 900 MW, $15B+ campus in Port Washington, Wisconsin, for Oracle's cloud, which serves OpenAI under Stargate. Oracle is the customer paying Vantage; lease terms were not disclosed.

deals.title: Anthropic expands Google Cloud use to up to one million TPUs, worth tens of billions

sources.quote: The expansion is worth tens of billions of dollars and is expected to bring well over a gigawatt of capacity online in 2026.

Anthropic will have access to up to one million TPU chips, as well as additional Google Cloud services, which will empower its research and development teams with leading AI-optimized infrastructure for years to come.

deals.explain: Anthropic agreed to rent up to one million of Google's TPU AI chips, more than a gigawatt of computing in 2026. The companies said it is worth 'tens of billions of dollars' but gave no exact number, so the amount is left blank.

deals.title: Nvidia joins Crusoe's $1.375B Series E

sources.quote: Share: Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity Partners co-lead funding to scale Crusoe’s vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform SAN FRANCISCO and DENVER – October 24 – Crusoe, the AI factory company, today announced the initial closing of its anticipated $1.375 billion Series E round, bringing the company's expected valuation to over $10 billion.

deals.explain: Nvidia was among the participants in Crusoe's $1.375 billion Series E, which valued Crusoe at over $10 billion. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Google signs 25-year PPA to restart NextEra's Duane Arnold nuclear plant

sources.quote: First, a subsidiary of NextEra Energy Resources has entered into a 25-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with Google that, pending regulatory approvals, will enable it to continue the recommissioning of the Duane Arnold nuclear plant in Palo, Iowa.

Once operational, Google will purchase power from the 615-MW plant as a 24/7 carbon-free energy source to help power Google's growing cloud and AI infrastructure in Iowa, while also strengthening local grid reliability, creating thousands of direct and indirect jobs, and driving significant economic investment to the Midwest region.

deals.explain: Google will buy power from Iowa's Duane Arnold nuclear plant for 25 years, which lets NextEra restart the 615 MW plant (closed in 2020) by early 2029; a local co-op, CIPCO, takes 50 MW on the same terms. Price not disclosed. Plant: Duane Arnold Energy Center, Palo, Iowa.

deals.title: Humain to deploy 200 MW of Qualcomm AI200/AI250 racks

sources.quote: Under the new program, HUMAIN plans to install 200 MW of Qualcomm’s AI200 and AI250 rack-scale solutions beginning in 2026.
Starting in 2026, HUMAIN plans to use 200 megawatts of Qualcomm AI200 and AI250 solutions to deliver high-performance AI inference services for businesses and public institutions.

deals.explain: Humain is the first big buyer of Qualcomm's new data-center AI chips, planning 200 megawatts of Qualcomm server racks from 2026 to run AI models for customers. No price was disclosed.

deals.title: Fluidstack signs 25-year, 168 MW lease with TeraWulf's Abernathy JV (~$9.5B)

sources.quote: The 25-year hosting commitment represents approximately $9.5 billion in contracted revenue to the joint venture.

deals.explain: Fluidstack committed to 25 years of rent for 168 megawatts at a new campus in Abernathy, Texas, owned by a joint venture that was 51% TeraWulf and 49% Fluidstack. In July 2026 TeraWulf agreed to sell its stake in that venture to a Fluidstack-led group.

deals.title: Nvidia invests $1B in Nokia

sources.quote: NVIDIA to invest USD 1.0 billion (EUR 0.86 billion) in new Nokia shares at a purchase price of USD 6.01 (EUR 5.16) per share
The share issue was completed on 13 November 2025 with NVIDIA becoming an approximately 2.90% shareholder of Nokia.

deals.explain: Nvidia bought $1 billion of newly issued Nokia shares, about 2.9% of the company, alongside a partnership on AI-powered mobile networks and data center networking. Nokia said it would use the money to push into networking for AI.

deals.title: OpenAI commits to buy an extra $250B of Microsoft Azure cloud services

sources.quote: OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250B of Azure services, and Microsoft will no longer have a right of first refusal to be OpenAI’s compute provider.
Under the new agreement, OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250 billion of Azure services, and Microsoft will no longer have a right of first refusal to be OpenAI's compute provider.

deals.explain: When OpenAI restructured into a for-profit public benefit corporation in October 2025, it signed a new deal with Microsoft promising to buy another $250 billion of Azure cloud computing. In return Microsoft gave up its right to be first in line for OpenAI's new computing needs.

deals.title: Oracle partners with Bloom for on-site fuel cell power at AI data centers

sources.quote: Bloom Energy is also addressing the surging power demands of artificial intelligence and cloud data centers through strategic agreements, including a $5.0 billion financing framework with Brookfield Asset Management and collaborations with Oracle and other hyperscale operators.

Forward-Looking Statements This Current Report on Form 8-K includes forward-looking statements, including statements regarding the anticipated benefits of the partnership between the Company and Oracle.

deals.explain: Bloom Energy supplies on-site fuel cell power to Oracle's AI data centers; as part of the partnership Bloom agreed on October 28, 2025 to give Oracle a warrant for about 3.5 million Bloom shares. Contract value not disclosed. Plants: Bloom fuel cell installations at Oracle (OCI) data centers.

deals.title: U.S. partners with Westinghouse on $80B+ of new reactors

sources.publisher: Brookfield Asset Management Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
sources.quote: At the center of the new strategic partnership, at least $80 billion of new reactors will be constructed across the United States using Westinghouse nuclear reactor technology.

deals.explain: The U.S. government signed a partnership with Westinghouse and its owners Brookfield and Cameco to get at least $80 billion of new Westinghouse nuclear reactors built in the U.S. The $80 billion is the headline value of reactors to be built, not cash already paid by the government; how much public money flows, and when, depends on later project deals.

deals.title: Google signs long-term special rate contract with Entergy Arkansas

sources.quote: Special Rate Contract and Arkansas Cypress Solar In September 2025, Entergy Arkansas filed an application with the APSC seeking approval of a long-term special rate contract between Altitude, LLC, a subsidiary of Alphabet, Inc. (Google) and Entergy Arkansas for the sale of electricity to a new large-scale data center in West Memphis, Arkansas.

In December 2025 the APSC issued an order approving the special rate contract but denying the requested ratemaking treatment of Google’s upfront payments and deferring a decision on the treatment under the contract pricing providing for the deferral and amortization of the investment tax credits from the Arkansas Cypress Solar facility (discussed below).

deals.explain: Google (through its subsidiary Altitude, LLC) signed a long-term contract to buy electricity from Entergy Arkansas for a new data center in West Memphis, including upfront payments and power from a new Arkansas Cypress Solar plant; regulators approved it in December 2025. Value not disclosed. Entergy filed it in September 2025; the date here is when Entergy first reported it in a filing. Plant: Arkansas Cypress Solar (planned), plus Entergy Arkansas system power.

deals.title: Eaton buys liquid-cooling maker Boyd Thermal for $9.5B

sources.quote: Under the terms of the agreement, Eaton will pay $9.5 billion for Boyd Thermal.
On March 12, 2026, Eaton acquired Boyd Thermal for $9.55 billion, net of cash acquired.

deals.explain: Power equipment maker Eaton agreed to pay $9.5 billion for Boyd Thermal, which makes liquid cooling systems that keep hot AI chips from overheating. The seller was Boyd's owner, Goldman Sachs Asset Management. The deal closed in March 2026 at $9.55 billion net of cash.

deals.title: Amazon (AWS) signs 15-year lease with Cipher (~$5.5B)

sources.quote: Cipher today announced an approximately $5.5 billion, 15-year lease agreement with Amazon Web Services to provide turnkey space and power for AI workloads.

deals.explain: Amazon Web Services agreed to rent 300 megawatts of capacity from Cipher (at its Black Pearl site in Texas) for 15 years for about $5.5 billion, Cipher's first lease directly with a big cloud company.

deals.title: Microsoft signs $9.7B AI cloud contract with IREN

sources.quote: The total contract value is approximately $9.7 billion through 2031, with 20% of the contract value for each tranche to be paid prior to the applicable delivery date and credited against the service fees due and payable after the 24th calendar month of the applicable GPU Service term on a pro rata basis.

deals.explain: Microsoft agreed to pay IREN about $9.7 billion over roughly five years for Nvidia GB300 GPU capacity at IREN's Childress, Texas campus, with 20% paid upfront before each tranche is delivered.

deals.title: Microsoft signs multibillion-dollar AI infrastructure deal with Lambda

sources.quote: SAN FRANCISCO, CA, November 3, 2025 — Lambda, the Superintelligence Cloud, today announced a multibillion-dollar agreement with Microsoft to deploy AI infrastructure powered by tens of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, including NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems.

deals.explain: Microsoft agreed to rent AI computing built on tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs from Lambda. The companies called it multibillion-dollar but did not give an exact figure.

deals.title: OpenAI signs $38B multi-year AWS cloud deal

sources.quote: Under this new $38 billion agreement, which will have continued growth over the next seven years, OpenAI is accessing AWS compute comprising hundreds of thousands of state-of-the-art NVIDIA GPUs, with the ability to expand to tens of millions of CPUs to rapidly scale agentic workloads.

deals.explain: OpenAI's first big contract with Amazon: $38 billion of AWS cloud computing, mainly Nvidia GPUs, over about seven years. It came days after OpenAI's new Microsoft deal ended Microsoft's first claim on OpenAI's computing needs.

deals.title: Vertiv buys liquid-cooling services firm PurgeRite for about $1B

sources.quote: today announced it has entered into an agreement to acquire Purge Rite Intermediate, LLC, (“PurgeRite”) a leading provider of mechanical flushing, purging and filtration services for data centers and other mission-critical facilities, from Milton Street Capital LLC for approximately $1.0 billion in cash consideration at closing

today announced the successful completion of its previously reported intent to acquire Purge Rite Intermediate LLC (“PurgeRite”), a leading provider of mechanical flushing, purging and filtration services for data centers and other mission-critical facilities.

deals.explain: Vertiv paid about $1 billion in cash to private equity firm Milton Street Capital for PurgeRite, which cleans and fills the pipes of liquid cooling systems in data centers. Liquid cooling is spreading because AI chips run too hot for air cooling. The deal closed in December 2025.

deals.title: Energy Transfer to supply natural gas to three Oracle data centers

sources.quote: Energy Transfer has now executed multiple agreements with Oracle, including previously announced agreements, to supply natural gas to three U.S. data centers, two of which are in Texas.

deals.explain: Pipeline company Energy Transfer signed several agreements to deliver natural gas to three Oracle data centers (two in Texas), which use gas to make their own power on site. Volumes and prices were not disclosed; the date is when Energy Transfer reported the full set of agreements.

deals.title: CoreWeave signs $1.17B deal making VAST Data its main data platform

sources.quote: VAST Data, the AI Operating System company, today announced it has signed a commercial agreement valued at $1.17 billion with CoreWeave, the essential cloud for AI.

deals.explain: CoreWeave, which rents out Nvidia GPUs, agreed to pay VAST Data about $1.17 billion for the software that stores and moves the data its AI customers train and run models on. It makes VAST the main data layer across CoreWeave's cloud.

deals.title: Meta signs ~$3B AI infrastructure deal with Nebius

sources.quote: Nebius today also announced a new agreement to deliver AI infrastructure to Meta valued at approximately $3 billion over 5 years.

deals.explain: Meta agreed to pay Nebius about $3 billion over five years for AI computing capacity.

deals.title: Anthropic picks Fluidstack for $50B US data center build

sources.quote: San Francisco, CA | Wednesday 12th November 2025 | 07:00 Fluidstack is announcing a $50 billion American computing infrastructure deal with Anthropic, building data centers in New York and Texas, with more sites to come.
We selected Fluidstack as our partner for its ability to move with exceptional agility, enabling rapid delivery of gigawatts of power.

deals.explain: Anthropic announced a $50 billion investment in US computing infrastructure and chose Fluidstack to build and run custom data centers in Texas and New York. The $50 billion is a multi-year headline total, and not all of it will necessarily be paid to Fluidstack.

deals.title: Google invests in Cursor maker Anysphere

sources.quote: We’re excited to deepen our work with existing investors, including Accel, Thrive, and Andreessen Horowitz, and welcome new partners Coatue, NVIDIA, and Google.

deals.explain: Google joined Anysphere's Series D as a new investor, amount not disclosed. Anysphere makes the Cursor AI coding app and was later bought by SpaceX.

deals.title: Nvidia invests in Cursor maker Anysphere

sources.quote: We’re excited to deepen our work with existing investors, including Accel, Thrive, and Andreessen Horowitz, and welcome new partners Coatue, NVIDIA, and Google.

deals.explain: Nvidia joined Anysphere's Series D as a new investor, amount not disclosed. Anysphere makes the Cursor AI coding app and was later bought by SpaceX.

deals.title: Anthropic commits to buy $30B of Microsoft Azure compute

sources.quote: Anthropic has committed to purchase $30 billion of Azure compute capacity and to contract additional compute capacity up to one gigawatt.

deals.explain: Anthropic agreed to buy $30 billion of computing from Microsoft's Azure cloud, running on Nvidia chips. In the same deal Microsoft and Nvidia said they would invest up to $5 billion and $10 billion in Anthropic, so some money flows both ways.

deals.title: Microsoft to invest up to $5B in Anthropic

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, NVIDIA and Microsoft are committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic.
Amazon, Google, and Microsoft, through their respective affiliates, have made significant equity investments in our company.

deals.explain: Microsoft committed up to $5 billion to Anthropic in November 2025, as Anthropic agreed to buy $30 billion of computing on Microsoft's Azure cloud. Anthropic's IPO filing confirms Microsoft is now a shareholder but does not give the amount paid.

deals.title: Nvidia to invest up to $10B in Anthropic

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, NVIDIA and Microsoft are committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic.
In November 2025, we entered into an agreement, subject to certain closing conditions, to invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic.

deals.explain: Nvidia agreed to invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic, subject to closing conditions, as part of a three-way deal in which Anthropic will run Claude on Nvidia systems in Microsoft's cloud.

deals.title: Energy Department lends Constellation $1B to restart Crane nuclear plant

sources.quote: The $1 billion loan to Constellation Energy Generation, LLC (Constellation) will help finance the Crane Clean Energy Center, an 835 MW plant located on the Susquehanna River in Londonderry Township, Pennsylvania.

sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Loan Programs Office
sources.quote: PROJECT SUMMARY In November 2025, EDF closed a $1 billion loan to Constellation Energy Generation, LLC (Constellation) to help finance the Crane Clean Energy Center (Crane) Restart project, a nuclear power plant in Londonderry Township, Pennsylvania.

deals.explain: The Energy Department lent Constellation $1 billion to help restart the 835-megawatt Crane nuclear plant in Pennsylvania, adding carbon-free power to a grid strained by data center demand.

deals.title: Digital Realty signs $373M power equipment deal with Schneider

sources.quote: Schneider Electric, a global energy technology leader, today announced that Digital Realty, (NYSE: DLR) the leading global provider of carrier-neutral data center, colocation, and interconnection solutions, has signed a $373 million Supply Capacity Agreement (SCA) for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), Low Voltage Switchgear (LVS), and Pre-Fabricated Skids.

deals.explain: Data center landlord Digital Realty reserved $373 million of Schneider Electric's production of backup power systems (UPS), switchgear and prefabricated equipment skids, guaranteeing it gets the gear on time for new data centers.

deals.title: Humain plans up to 600,000 Nvidia GPUs over three years

sources.quote: The Saudi Public Investment Fund’s AI company HUMAIN and NVIDIA have announced an expanded strategic partnership, together with plans to deploy up to 600,000 of NVIDIA’s latest AI infrastructure technologies over the next three years including Blackwell (GB300) platforms.

deals.explain: Humain widened its Nvidia plan at the US-Saudi Investment Forum: up to 600,000 Nvidia AI chips over three years, in Saudi Arabia and the US. This is a plan with no price; analyst cost estimates are not included.

deals.title: Switch signs $1.9B power and cooling supply deal with Schneider

sources.quote: Schneider Electric, a global energy technology leader, and Switch, a premier provider of AI, cloud and enterprise data centers, today announced a two-phase supply capacity agreement (SCA) totaling $1.9 billion in sales.

deals.explain: Data center operator Switch reserved $1.9 billion of Schneider Electric's factory output of prefabricated power modules and chillers for its AI data centers. Locking in supply ahead of time is how builders avoid long waits for scarce electrical and cooling gear.

deals.title: Fluidstack adds 39 MW at Cipher's Barber Lake (~$830M)

sources.quote: The agreement represents approximately $830 million in contracted revenue over the initial 10-year term and includes two five-year extension options.

deals.explain: Fluidstack expanded its Barber Lake lease by 39 megawatts, taking the whole 300-megawatt site, adding about $830 million of rent over 10 years. Google expanded its backstop of Fluidstack's payments.

deals.title: Marvell buys Celestial AI for $3.25B upfront (up to $5.5B)

sources.quote: Marvell will acquire Celestial AI for upfront consideration valued at approximately $3.25 billion, consisting of $1.0 billion in cash, as well as approximately 27.2 million shares of Marvell common stock, having a value of $2.25 billion, based on the average volume weighted average price (VWAP) for the 10 trading days ending the second day prior to signing.

Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL), a leader in data infrastructure semiconductor solutions, today announced that it has completed its previously announced acquisition of Celestial AI, a pioneer in optical interconnect technology for scale-up connectivity.

deals.explain: Marvell bought Celestial AI, which uses light (photonics) to connect AI chips, for $3.25B in cash and stock upfront, plus up to $2.25B more in stock if revenue targets are hit. The amount shown is the upfront part only. The deal closed in February 2026.

deals.title: Meta signs ~2.5 GW of solar and storage contracts with NextEra

sources.quote: The 2.5-GW milestone was reached with the signing of 11 power purchase agreements (PPA) and two energy storage agreements (ESA).

deals.explain: Meta signed 11 power purchase agreements and two storage agreements with NextEra Energy Resources for about 2.5 GW across 13 new solar and battery projects in Texas (ERCOT), SPP, MISO and New Mexico, coming online 2026-2028. Prices not disclosed. Plants: 13 new NextEra projects, mostly unnamed; four are in Valencia and De Baca counties, New Mexico.

deals.title: Meta signs Oracle cloud deal, reported at about $20B

sources.quote: “Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) increased by $68 billion in Q2—up 15% sequentially to $523 billion—highlighted by new commitments from Meta, NVIDIA, and others,” said Oracle Principal Financial Officer, Doug Kehring.
Oracle would provide Meta with computing capacity for training and deploying AI models, in addition to Meta's existing cloud computing providers, the person said.

deals.explain: Meta is renting AI computing from Oracle. Oracle confirmed a new Meta commitment in its December 2025 earnings release but gave no amount; in September 2025 Reuters and Bloomberg reported the two were negotiating a deal of about $20 billion, so the figure is an estimate.

deals.title: Nvidia signs new cloud commitment with Oracle

sources.quote: “Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) increased by $68 billion in Q2—up 15% sequentially to $523 billion—highlighted by new commitments from Meta, NVIDIA, and others,” said Oracle Principal Financial Officer, Doug Kehring.

deals.explain: Nvidia, which sells the chips inside Oracle's data centers, also buys computing back from Oracle's cloud. Oracle named Nvidia as one of the customers behind a $68 billion jump in its contracted backlog in late 2025, without saying how much Nvidia committed.

deals.title: Anthropic places further $11B TPU rack order with Broadcom

sources.quote: Anthropic has since placed an additional order valued at $11 billion that Tan said is scheduled for delivery later next year.

deals.explain: After its first $10B order, Anthropic ordered another $11B of Google TPU-based server racks from Broadcom for delivery in late 2026, as disclosed by Broadcom's CEO on the December 2025 earnings call.

deals.title: Fluidstack signs 15-year, 245 MW lease at Hut 8's River Bend ($7.0B)

sources.quote: Base-Term Contract Value: Total contract value of $7.0 billion over a 15-year base lease term, inclusive of a 3.0% annual base rent escalator.

deals.explain: Fluidstack signed a 15-year, $7 billion lease for 245 megawatts at Hut 8's River Bend campus in Louisiana; Google backstops the lease payments. The capacity is widely tied to Anthropic, which works with Fluidstack.

deals.title: Alphabet agrees to buy Intersect for $4.75B cash plus debt

sources.quote: Kirkland & Ellis advised a group of investors in Intersect on a definitive agreement to sell Intersect, which provides data center and energy infrastructure solutions, for $4.75 billion in cash, plus the assumption of debt, to Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG).

deals.explain: Alphabet agreed to buy Intersect, a developer that builds power plants together with data centers, for $4.75 billion in cash plus assumed debt; the cash goes to sellers TPG Rise Climate, Climate Adaptive Infrastructure and Greenbelt Capital. Google already owned a minority stake. Intersect's operating Texas and California assets are excluded from the deal.

deals.title: Nvidia pays $17B to license Groq's inference chip tech and hire its team

sources.quote: Total consideration consists of $13.0 billion paid at closing and $4 billion, inclusive of imputed interest, payable within one year included in Accrued and Other Current Liabilities on our Consolidated Balance Sheets.
Today, Groq announced that it has entered into a non-exclusive licensing agreement with Nvidia for Groq’s inference technology.

deals.explain: Nvidia paid Groq for a non-exclusive license to its fast AI inference chip design and hired Groq's founder and other staff, without buying the company. Nvidia's annual report puts the total at $17B ($13B at closing plus $4B within a year); early news reports said about $20B.

deals.title: SoftBank buys DigitalBridge for ~$4B

sources.quote: Transaction Details Under the terms of the agreement, SoftBank Group will indirectly acquire all the outstanding common stock of DigitalBridge for $16.00 per share in cash.

SoftBank Group Corp. (“SBG”) today announced that on September 30, 2026 (U.S. time), it completed the acquisition of all the outstanding common stock of DigitalBridge Group, Inc. (“DigitalBridge”), a leading global alternative asset manager dedicated to investing in digital infrastructure for approximately USD 3.1 billion.

deals.explain: SoftBank bought DigitalBridge, a firm that invests in data centers, towers and fiber, for $16 a share in cash. The deal was announced at an enterprise value of about $4.0 billion (including debt); the shares themselves cost about $3.1 billion when it closed in September 2026.

deals.title: Vistra agrees to buy Cogentrix's 5.5 GW gas fleet for ~$4.0B

sources.quote: IRVING, Texas, Jan. 5, 2026 — Vistra Corp. (NYSE: VST) today announced it has executed definitive agreements to acquire Cogentrix Energy, consisting of 10 modern natural gas generation facilities totaling approximately 5,500 MW of capacity.
The approximately $4.0 billion net purchase price implies a multiple of approximately 7.25x the 2027 expected Adjusted EBITDA contribution and approximately $730/kW for the portfolio.

deals.explain: Vistra agreed to buy Cogentrix Energy, owned by funds of Quantum Capital Group, for a net purchase price of about $4.0 billion, adding 10 gas plants (about 5,500 MW) in PJM, New England and Texas to serve rising demand including data centers. Expected to close mid-to-late 2026. Plants named in the release: Patriot and Hamilton-Liberty (Pennsylvania), among 10 facilities.

deals.title: Cisco invests in xAI's $20B Series E

sources.quote: Strategic investors in the round include NVIDIA and Cisco Investments, who continue to support xAI in rapidly scaling our compute infrastructure and buildout of the largest GPU clusters in the world.

deals.explain: Cisco's venture arm invested an undisclosed amount in xAI's $20 billion Series E round. Cisco sells networking gear used in AI data centers.

deals.title: Fidelity invests in xAI's Series E

sources.quote: Investors participating in the round include Valor Equity Partners, Stepstone Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX and Baron Capital Group, amongst other key partners.

deals.explain: Fidelity's funds took part in xAI's $20 billion Series E (counted in full on the Valor record); the amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: MGX invests in xAI's Series E

sources.quote: Investors participating in the round include Valor Equity Partners, Stepstone Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX and Baron Capital Group, amongst other key partners.

deals.explain: Abu Dhabi's MGX took part in xAI's $20 billion Series E (counted in full on the Valor record); its amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia invests in xAI's $20B Series E

sources.quote: Strategic investors in the round include NVIDIA and Cisco Investments, who continue to support xAI in rapidly scaling our compute infrastructure and buildout of the largest GPU clusters in the world.

deals.explain: Nvidia was a strategic investor in xAI's $20 billion Series E round; its own amount was not disclosed. xAI spends heavily on Nvidia chips for its Colossus supercomputers.

deals.title: Qatar's QIA invests in xAI's Series E

sources.quote: Investors participating in the round include Valor Equity Partners, Stepstone Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX and Baron Capital Group, amongst other key partners.

deals.explain: Qatar's sovereign wealth fund took part in xAI's $20 billion Series E (counted in full on the Valor record); its amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Valor-backed $20B Series E for xAI

sources.quote: xAI completed its upsized Series E funding round, exceeding the $15 billion targeted round size, and raised $20 billion.

Investors participating in the round include Valor Equity Partners, Stepstone Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX and Baron Capital Group, amongst other key partners.

deals.explain: xAI raised $20 billion, more than its $15 billion target, from Valor, StepStone, Fidelity, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX, Baron Capital and others. No lead was named; the whole round is shown on this Valor record and each investor's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Meta prepays Oklo to develop a 1.2 GW nuclear campus in Ohio

sources.quote: On January 5, 2026, we entered into a prepayment agreement (the "Prepayment Agreement") with Meta Platforms, Inc. ("Meta") that advances plans to develop a 1.2 gigawatt power campus in Pike County, Ohio, to support Meta’s data centers.
Our partnership with Oklo helps advance the development of entirely new nuclear energy in Pike County, Ohio.

deals.explain: Meta is paying Oklo in advance for future power so Oklo can buy nuclear fuel and start building a planned 1.2 GW campus of Aurora reactors in Pike County, Ohio. The prepayment amount was not disclosed. The agreement was signed January 5, 2026 and announced January 9. Plants: planned Oklo Aurora powerhouses, Pike County, Ohio (not yet built).

deals.title: Meta funds two TerraPower Natrium reactors, with options for up to eight

sources.quote: Our agreement with TerraPower will provide funding that supports the development of two new Natrium® units capable of generating up to 690 MW of firm power with delivery as early as 2032.

deals.explain: Meta is funding TerraPower's development of two new Natrium sodium-cooled reactors (up to 690 MW, power as early as 2032), with rights to more units (Meta says up to eight in total). No dollar amount was disclosed. Plants: planned TerraPower Natrium units (not yet built, sites not named).

deals.title: Meta signs 20-year PPAs for 2,609 MW from Vistra nuclear plants

sources.quote: In January 2026, Vistra Corp. (“Vistra” or the “Company”) announced that it has entered into 20-year power purchase agreements (“PPAs”) with Meta Platforms, Inc. (“Meta”), pursuant to which the Company has agreed to supply Meta with a total of 2,609 MW of carbon-free power and capacity from the Company’s PJM nuclear power plants as follows:

Through additional 20-year nuclear energy agreements, we will purchase more than 2.1 GW of energy from two operating Vistra nuclear power plants in Ohio (Perry and Davis-Besse), in addition to the energy from expansions (uprates) at these two Ohio plants and a third Vistra nuclear plant in Pennsylvania (Beaver Valley).

deals.explain: Meta will buy power for 20 years from Vistra's nuclear plants: 1,268 MW from Perry and 908 MW from Davis-Besse (Ohio), plus 433 MW of new 'uprate' capacity at Perry, Davis-Besse and Beaver Valley (Pennsylvania), 2,609 MW in total. No dollar value was disclosed. Plants: Perry Nuclear Power Plant, Davis-Besse Nuclear Power Station, Beaver Valley Power Station.

deals.title: Apple to base next Siri and Apple Intelligence models on Google Gemini (~$1B a year reported)

sources.quote: Apple and Google have entered into a multi-year collaboration under which the next generation of Apple Foundation Models will be based on Google's Gemini models and cloud technology.
Apple will pay Google about $1 billion a year to use a model with 1.2 trillion parameters.
The price tag is rumored to be roughly $1 billion a year, though neither company has confirmed terms.

deals.explain: Apple is paying Google to use its Gemini AI models as the base for the next Siri and Apple Intelligence. The deal is multi-year; Bloomberg reported Apple would pay about $1 billion per year (the amount shown is one year, not the total), and neither company has confirmed the price.

deals.title: OpenAI buys 750 MW of Cerebras inference compute (over $20B)

sources.quote: In January 2026, we announced a multi-year deal with OpenAI valued at more than $20 billion dollars.

In December 2025, we entered into a Master Relationship Agreement (the “MRA”) with OpenAI OpCo, LLC (“OpenAI”), under which OpenAI agreed to purchase 750MW of AI inference compute capacity (the “Committed Capacity”) and related services, including collaboration on engineering development and integrations.

deals.explain: OpenAI agreed to buy 750 megawatts of AI computing from Cerebras, delivered in stages from 2026 through 2028, to make ChatGPT answers faster. Cerebras says the deal is worth more than $20B (the amount shown is that floor); OpenAI can also buy up to 1.25 GW more. News reports at announcement put it at about $10B.

deals.title: OpenAI lends Cerebras $1B to build out capacity

sources.quote: Under the MRA with OpenAI, OpenAI has provided us with the $1.0 billion Working Capital Loan to accelerate the development and build out of services, technology, and manufacturing.

deals.explain: As part of its compute deal, OpenAI lent Cerebras $1B (paid in January 2026) so Cerebras could build the systems OpenAI ordered. Cerebras repays it in installments after delivering the first 250 MW, by 2032 at the latest.

deals.title: Tesla invests about $2B in xAI

sources.quote: On January 16, 2026, Tesla entered into an agreement to invest approximately $2 billion to acquire shares of Series E Preferred Stock of xAI as part of their recent publicly-disclosed financing round.
In January 2026, Tesla entered into an agreement with xAI to invest $2,000 million via a purchase of xAI Series E Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock.

deals.explain: Tesla agreed to put about $2 billion into Elon Musk's AI company xAI in its Series E round. After SpaceX bought xAI, Tesla's stake was converted into SpaceX shares.

deals.title: Nvidia invests $2B in CoreWeave stock

sources.quote: In addition, NVIDIA has invested $2 billion in CoreWeave Class A common stock at a purchase price of $87.20 per share.

deals.explain: Nvidia bought $2 billion of new CoreWeave shares at $87.20 each. CoreWeave spends heavily on Nvidia chips, so part of this money can cycle back to Nvidia as GPU purchases.

deals.title: Meta to buy up to $6B of fiber optic products from Corning

sources.quote: Corning and Meta Announce Multiyear, Up to $6-Billion Agreement
Meta, USA, and Corning, USA, have entered into a multiyear, up to US$6 billion partnership designed to advance the construction of cutting-edge data center infrastructure across the United States.

deals.explain: Meta agreed to buy optical fiber, cable and connectors from Corning for its US AI data centers over several years, worth up to $6 billion. 'Up to' means $6 billion is a ceiling, not a guaranteed total. Corning is expanding its North Carolina factories to fill the order.

deals.title: Perplexity signs ~$750M, three-year Microsoft Azure deal

sources.quote: AI startup Perplexity has signed a $750 million agreement with Microsoft to use its Azure cloud service, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The deal, valued at about $750 million, gives the Nvidia-backed company access to Microsoft’s Foundry platform, which aggregates models from multiple developers including OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI.

deals.explain: AI search company Perplexity agreed to spend about $750 million over three years on Microsoft's Azure cloud, mainly to use AI models from several labs through Microsoft's Foundry service. The figure comes from Bloomberg's sources, not the companies; AWS remains Perplexity's main cloud.

deals.title: Sandisk to pay Kioxia $1.165B to extend flash joint venture to 2034

sources.quote: As part of this renewed agreement, Sandisk will pay Kioxia USD 1.165 billion for manufacturing services and continued availability of supply.
As part of this renewed agreement, Sandisk will pay Kioxia USD 1.165 billion for manufacturing services and continued availability of supply.

deals.explain: Sandisk and Kioxia make flash memory together in Japanese factories. To keep that arrangement going through 2034, Sandisk will pay Kioxia $1.165 billion in installments from 2026 to 2029 for manufacturing services and guaranteed access to supply.

deals.title: SpaceX acquires xAI in an all-stock deal

sources.quote: On February 2, 2026 (“xAI Merger Date”), the Company completed its acquisition of X.AI Holdings Corp.
The transaction values SpaceX at US$1 trillion, and xAI at US$250 billion, according to a person familiar with the matter.

deals.explain: SpaceX bought xAI (which already owned X, formerly Twitter) by swapping xAI shares for SpaceX shares, so little cash changed hands. A source put xAI's value at about $250 billion. Both companies are controlled by Elon Musk.

deals.title: Intel reportedly to invest about $100M in SambaNova

sources.quote: Other investors in the oversubscribed round include existing backer Intel Corp, which currently plans to invest about $100 million, with potential commitments of up to $150 million, two of the sources said.

deals.explain: After talks for Intel to buy SambaNova for about $1.6B stalled, Intel instead planned to put about $100M (possibly up to $150M) into SambaNova's new funding round, according to Reuters sources. Later reports put Intel's actual February investment at a smaller $35M, so the amount is uncertain.

deals.title: AEP commits $2.65B to Bloom fuel cells for a Wyoming power project

sources.quote: In January 2026, under the existing option to acquire additional fuel cells, an unregulated AEP subsidiary entered into an agreement to acquire solid oxide fuel cells for approximately $2.65 billion to develop a fuel cell generation facility near Cheyenne, Wyoming.

AEP was proactive in securing Bloom Energy fuel cells which has positioned the company very well to pursue early development of a generation facility project in Wyoming, backed by $2.65 billion in fuel cell purchase commitments.

deals.explain: Using its option from the 2024 deal, an AEP subsidiary agreed in January 2026 to buy about $2.65 billion of Bloom Energy fuel cells for a power plant near Cheyenne, Wyoming, aimed at data center demand. AEP's filings give only the month (January 2026), so the date here is when AEP disclosed it (Feb 12, 2026). Plant: planned AEP fuel cell facility near Cheyenne, Wyoming.

deals.title: Coatue co-leads Anthropic's Series G

sources.quote: We have raised $30 billion in Series G funding led by GIC and Coatue, valuing Anthropic at $380 billion post-money.

deals.explain: Coatue co-led Anthropic's $30 billion Series G (counted in full on the GIC record). Coatue's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Founders Fund co-leads Anthropic's Series G

sources.quote: The round was co-led by D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ, and MGX.

deals.explain: Founders Fund was one of the co-leads of Anthropic's $30 billion Series G (counted in full on the GIC record). Its own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: GIC and Coatue lead Anthropic's $30B Series G

sources.quote: We have raised $30 billion in Series G funding led by GIC and Coatue, valuing Anthropic at $380 billion post-money.
This round also includes a portion of the previously announced investments from Microsoft and NVIDIA.

deals.explain: Singapore's GIC co-led, with Coatue, a $30 billion funding round for Anthropic at a $380 billion valuation. The amount shown is the whole round, which includes part of money Microsoft and Nvidia had already promised; GIC's own share was not disclosed.

deals.title: MGX co-leads Anthropic's Series G

sources.quote: The round was co-led by D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ, and MGX.

deals.explain: Abu Dhabi's MGX was one of the co-leads of Anthropic's $30 billion Series G (counted in full on the GIC record). Its own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Meta signs multiyear deal for millions of Nvidia GPUs and CPUs

sources.quote: This partnership will enable the large-scale deployment of NVIDIA CPUs and millions of NVIDIA Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, as well as the integration of NVIDIA Spectrum-X™ Ethernet switches for Meta's Facebook Open Switching System platform.

deals.explain: Meta agreed to buy millions of Nvidia's current and next-generation AI chips, plus Nvidia CPUs and network switches, over several years. Terms were not disclosed; analysts estimate tens of billions of dollars.

deals.title: Xcel to power Google's Minnesota data center with 1.9 GW of new clean energy

sources.quote: NSP System — Large Load Agreement — In the first quarter of 2026, NSP-Minnesota entered into an electric service agreement to power a new Google data center in Minnesota.

The agreement includes adding an additional 1,400 megawatts (MW) of wind, 200 MW of solar and 300 MW of iron-air battery storage from Form Energy to Xcel’s grid, providing a thoughtfully designed grid balanced solution.

deals.explain: Google signed an electric service agreement with Xcel Energy for a new data center in Pine Island, Minnesota, paying all costs of its service; the deal adds 1,400 MW of wind, 200 MW of solar and 300 MW of iron-air batteries to Xcel's grid, and Google gives $50 million to Xcel's Capacity*Connect battery program. Total value not disclosed. Plants: new, unnamed Xcel wind, solar and Form Energy storage projects.

deals.title: Meta to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs

sources.quote: AMD and Meta agree to a definitive multi-year, multi-generation partnership to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct™ GPUs

As part of the agreement, to further align strategic interests, AMD has issued Meta a performance-based warrant for up to 160 million shares of AMD common stock, structured to vest as specific milestones associated with Instinct GPU shipments are achieved.

deals.explain: Meta signed a definitive deal to buy AMD AI chips worth up to 6 gigawatts of capacity, starting with 1 gigawatt in late 2026. AMD gave Meta a warrant for up to 160 million AMD shares that vests as shipments happen. AMD gave no dollar figure; press reports ranged from about $60B to over $100B.

deals.title: Meta reportedly rents Google Cloud TPU chips in multibillion-dollar deal

sources.quote: Meta Platforms Inc. has reportedly agreed to a multibillion-dollar deal to rent Google Cloud’s custom artificial intelligence chips, according to a report in The Information today.

deals.explain: Meta reportedly agreed to rent Google's TPU AI chips through Google Cloud to train its next models, as it tries to rely less on Nvidia. Reports call it multibillion-dollar but give no exact figure, and the companies have not announced it.

deals.title: Amazon invests $50B in OpenAI

sources.quote: Amazon will also invest $50 billion in OpenAI, starting with an initial $15 billion investment and followed by another $35 billion in the coming months when certain conditions are met.
Subsequent to June 30, 2026, we invested the remaining $21.3 billion Commitment Amount in shares of Series C Preferred Stock of OpenAI.

deals.explain: Amazon agreed to buy $50 billion of OpenAI preferred shares: $15 billion up front and $35 billion later, which it had fully paid by mid-2026. Alongside it, OpenAI expanded its spending on Amazon's AWS cloud, so part of the money circles back to Amazon.

deals.title: Nvidia invests $30B in OpenAI, replacing the $100B plan

sources.quote: Nvidia and SoftBank are each investing $30bn.

Nvidia is close to finalising a $30 billion equity investment in OpenAI, the Financial Times reported Thursday, in a deal that replaces the $100 billion multiyear infrastructure commitment the two companies announced last September.
Under the proposed terms, Nvidia would take a direct stake in OpenAI, replacing a previously mooted $100 billion multi‑year investment announced in 2025 but never formalised.

deals.explain: Instead of the earlier 'up to $100 billion' plan tied to data center build-outs, Nvidia bought $30 billion of OpenAI shares outright in OpenAI's 2026 funding round, which closed at $122 billion. Much of OpenAI's new money is expected to flow back to Nvidia for chips.

deals.title: OpenAI expands its AWS cloud deal by $100B over 8 years

sources.quote: OpenAI and AWS are expanding their existing $38 billion multi-year agreement by $100 billion over 8 years.

In Q1 2026, AWS and OpenAI Group PBC (“OpenAI”) announced an expansion of the existing $38.0 billion multi-year commitment and commercial arrangement with OpenAI by $100.0 billion over 8.0 years, which includes contractual obligations related to the performance of AWS chips.

deals.explain: On top of its earlier $38 billion AWS contract, OpenAI agreed to spend another $100 billion on Amazon's cloud over eight years, including about 2 gigawatts of Amazon's own Trainium AI chips. It came alongside Amazon's plan to invest $50 billion in OpenAI, so money flows both ways.

deals.title: SoftBank invests another $30B in OpenAI

sources.quote: Upon completion of the Follow-on Investment, SBG’s cumulative investment in OpenAI is expected to total USD 64.6 billion, representing an ownership interest of approximately 13%.
Following the Third Tranche Investment, SBG has now completed the USD 30.0 billion follow-on investments in OpenAI previously announced.

deals.explain: In February 2026 SoftBank agreed to put another $30 billion into OpenAI's new funding round, paid in three $10 billion pieces in April, July and October 2026, partly with borrowed money. That brought SoftBank's total OpenAI investment to $64.6 billion for about 13% of the company.

deals.title: Broadcom to fund up to $42B of Anthropic notes

sources.quote: we have the ability to issue, if needed, up to $42.0 billion in aggregate principal amount of convertible promissory notes to Broadcom or, subject to our consent (not to be unreasonably withheld), a designated financial partner pursuant to a note purchase agreement that we entered into with Broadcom in March 2026

deals.explain: Anthropic can borrow up to $42 billion from Broadcom (or a lender Broadcom picks) through convertible notes, to pay for computing infrastructure it leases. Nothing had been drawn as of the IPO filing. The filing gives only the month, so the date here is March 1, 2026.

deals.title: Nvidia invests $2B in optics maker Coherent

sources.quote: In addition, NVIDIA is investing $2 billion in Coherent to support research and development, future capacity and operations as Coherent builds out its U.S.- based manufacturing capabilities.

deals.explain: Nvidia agreed to invest $2 billion in Coherent, a maker of lasers and optical transceivers for data center networks, to fund research and new US manufacturing. It was announced the same day as a matching $2 billion investment in Lumentum.

deals.title: Nvidia signs multi-billion optics purchase commitment with Coherent

sources.quote: The non-exclusive agreement includes an NVIDIA multi-billion-dollar purchase commitment and future access and capacity rights for advanced laser and optical networking products.

deals.explain: Alongside its $2 billion investment, Nvidia committed to buy lasers and optical networking products from Coherent over several years. The deal was described only as multi-billion-dollar, so no exact amount is recorded.

deals.title: Nvidia invests $2B in laser maker Lumentum

sources.quote: In addition, NVIDIA is investing $2 billion in Lumentum to support R&D, future capacity and operations as the company builds out its U.S.-based manufacturing capabilities in a new fab.

deals.explain: Nvidia agreed to invest $2 billion in Lumentum, which makes the lasers inside optical links that connect AI chips. The money is meant to fund research and a new US factory, so Nvidia can count on enough optical parts for future AI systems.

deals.title: Nvidia signs multi-billion laser purchase commitment with Lumentum

sources.quote: The non-exclusive agreement includes an NVIDIA multi-billion purchase commitment and future capacity access rights for advanced laser components.

deals.explain: Alongside its $2 billion investment, Nvidia promised to buy laser components from Lumentum over several years. The companies called it a multi-billion purchase commitment but gave no exact figure, so the amount is left blank here.

deals.title: Nvidia joins Nscale's $2B Series C

sources.quote: The funding round was supported by Astra Capital Management, Citadel, Dell, Jane Street, Lenovo, Linden Advisors, Nokia, NVIDIA, and Point72.

deals.explain: Nvidia invested again in Nscale's $2 billion Series C, which valued Nscale at $14.6 billion. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia invests $2B in Nebius

sources.quote: NVIDIA will invest $2 billion in Nebius, reflecting NVIDIA's confidence in Nebius's business and unique depth of engineering expertise across the full AI technology stack.
In Q1, we raised $6.3 billion, including the $2 billion equi-ty investment from NVIDIA, and $4.3 billion from convertible securities at favourable rates.

deals.explain: Nvidia invested $2 billion in Nebius as part of a partnership for Nebius to deploy more than 5 gigawatts of Nvidia systems by 2030. Much of Nebius's spending goes to Nvidia hardware, so the money partly returns to Nvidia.

deals.title: AWS to deploy Cerebras systems in its own data centers

sources.quote: In March 2026, we signed a term sheet with AWS, under which AWS will become the first hyperscaler to deploy Cerebras in its own data centers.

deals.explain: Amazon Web Services signed a binding term sheet to lease and buy Cerebras AI inference systems for its own data centers, paired with Amazon's Trainium chips. Cerebras also agreed to give AWS a warrant for up to about 2.7 million shares tied to large purchases. No dollar value was given.

deals.title: Meta commits to buy up to $15B of extra Nebius capacity

sources.quote: Furthermore, in connection with access to these NVIDIA Vera Rubin deployments, Meta has committed to purchase additional available compute capacity across certain upcoming Nebius clusters up to a total of $15 billion over a five-year period.

deals.explain: On top of its $12 billion deal, Meta agreed to buy up to $15 billion of spare capacity in upcoming Nebius clusters that Nebius cannot sell to other customers. It works like a backstop, so actual spending may be lower.

deals.title: Meta signs $12B five-year capacity deal with Nebius

sources.quote: Under the five-year agreement, Nebius will provide $12 billion of dedicated capacity across multiple locations, based on one of the first large-scale deployments of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform.

deals.explain: Meta agreed to buy $12 billion of dedicated AI computing capacity from Nebius over five years, running on Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin chips.

deals.title: Micron ships HBM4 memory for Nvidia's Vera Rubin

sources.quote: Micron Technology, Inc., has begun volume shipment of its HBM4 36GB 12H in the first quarter of calendar year 2026 and is designed for Nvidia Vera Rubin.
Micron Technology has begun volume shipment of its HBM4 36GB 12H in the first quarter of calendar year 2026 and is designed for Nvidia Vera Rubin.

deals.explain: Micron began volume shipments of its next-generation HBM4 memory designed for Nvidia's Vera Rubin AI platform in early 2026, so Nvidia is paying Micron for this memory. The value was not disclosed.

deals.title: Crusoe builds 900 MW Abilene AI campus for Microsoft

sources.quote: Supporting large scale AI workloads for Microsoft, the 900 MW site includes two new buildings and an onsite power plant to support grid resilience.

deals.explain: Crusoe is developing a dedicated 900-megawatt AI data center campus in Abilene, Texas for Microsoft's AI workloads. Financial terms were not disclosed.

deals.title: Anthropic to access about 3.5 GW of TPU compute through Broadcom

sources.quote: Separately, Broadcom, Google and Anthropic PBC (“Anthropic”) have expanded their current strategic collaboration under which Anthropic, beginning in 2027, will access through Broadcom approximately 3.5 gigawatts as part of the multiple gigawatts of next generation TPU-based AI compute capacity committed by Anthropic.

deals.explain: Starting in 2027, Anthropic will get about 3.5 gigawatts of next-generation Google TPU computing through Broadcom. Broadcom gave no price and warned that how much Anthropic uses depends on Anthropic's continued commercial success.

deals.title: Anthropic signs multi-gigawatt Google TPU deal, reportedly worth $200B over five years

sources.quote: We have signed a new agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity that we expect to come online starting in 2027.
Anthropic has committed to spend $200 billion with Google Cloud over five years as part of a recent agreement, The Information reported on Tuesday, citing a person with knowledge of the matter.

deals.explain: Anthropic agreed to rent several gigawatts of Google's TPU AI chips (designed with Broadcom), coming online from 2027. Anthropic gave no price; The Information reported Anthropic committed to spend $200 billion with Google Cloud over five years, which would be a large share of Google Cloud's backlog.

deals.title: Google signs long-term deal for Broadcom to supply future TPUs

sources.quote: Broadcom Inc. (“Broadcom”) and Google LLC (“Google”) have entered into a Long Term Agreement for Broadcom to develop and supply custom Tensor Processing Units (“TPUs”) for Google’s future generations of TPUs and a Supply Assurance Agreement for Broadcom to supply networking and other components to be used in Google’s next-generation AI racks through up to 2031.

deals.explain: Google pays Broadcom to co-design and supply its custom AI chips (TPUs) for future generations, plus networking parts for its AI racks, through as late as 2031. No dollar amount was disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia joins Firmus's $505M round at $5.5B valuation

sources.quote: The raise, announced on 6 April 2026 and led by Coatue Management with continued participation from Nvidia, is the third equity round Firmus has completed in six months, bringing total equity raised in that period to approximately $1.35bn.

deals.explain: Nvidia invested again in Firmus's $505 million round at a $5.5 billion valuation. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Meta signs ~$21B expanded AI cloud deal with CoreWeave

sources.quote: CoreWeave (Nasdaq: CRWV), the Essential Cloud for AI™, today announced an expanded, long-term agreement with Meta Platforms, Inc. to provide AI cloud capacity through December 2032 for approximately $21 billion.

(“Meta”) initially committed to pay us up to approximately $21.0 billion (inclusive of access to new computing capacity through December 20, 2032 and the exercise of an existing option to access additional computing capacity through April 10, 2032) and, as a result, we also expect Meta to be a significant customer in future periods.

deals.explain: A new Meta order with CoreWeave worth up to about $21 billion through December 2032, mostly for running AI models (inference). The figure includes Meta exercising the expansion option from its September 2025 deal, so the two should not simply be read as one bigger number.

deals.title: Oracle plans to procure up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel cells

sources.quote: Under a master services agreement, Oracle intends to procure up to 2.8 gigawatts (GW) of Bloom’s fuel cell systems.

deals.explain: Oracle expanded its Bloom Energy deal with a master services agreement under which it intends to procure up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel cell systems for U.S. cloud and AI data centers. 'Intends to' and 'up to' mean this is a ceiling, not a firm order; no price was disclosed.

deals.title: Microsoft expands Nscale deal with 30,000+ Rubin GPUs in Narvik

sources.quote: Expanding Nscale and Microsoft’s previous deal, the 230 MW Nscale Narvik campus will add more than 30,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs in deployment, making it one of the largest onshore infrastructure projects in Norway.

deals.explain: Microsoft expanded its Nscale contract with more than 30,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs at Nscale's Narvik, Norway campus. Terms were not disclosed.

deals.title: Amazon offers Anthropic up to $20B more in funding

sources.quote: Additionally, we entered into a financing arrangement to make available to Anthropic an aggregate facility not to exceed $20.0 billion that will expire 30 months after an Anthropic liquidity event, including an initial public offering (“IPO”).

deals.explain: Besides its $5 billion share purchase, Amazon set up a facility that lets Anthropic draw up to $20 billion more as Amazon delivers computing capacity. Amazon has already used $5 billion of it to join Anthropic's Series H round, leaving $15 billion.

deals.title: Amazon invests $5B more in Anthropic

sources.quote: In April 2026, the Company entered into a stock purchase and convertible note facility agreement (“Amazon 2026 NPA”) with Amazon under which Amazon purchased 19.3 million shares of the Company’s Series G-2 non-voting redeemable convertible preferred stock for approximately $5.0 billion
