deals.explain: Amazon bought $5 billion of Anthropic shares in April 2026, at the same time as Anthropic promised to spend more than $100 billion on AWS over ten years. Amazon also offered up to $20 billion more later (a separate record).

deals.title: Anthropic commits more than $100B to AWS over ten years

sources.quote: Expanding on this success, today Amazon and Anthropic are deepening their collaboration with a commitment from Anthropic to spend more than $100 billion over the next ten years on AWS technologies.

deals.explain: Anthropic promised to spend more than $100 billion over ten years on Amazon's cloud, securing up to 5 gigawatts of computing built largely on Amazon's Trainium chips. At the same time Amazon agreed to invest $5 billion more in Anthropic, with up to $20 billion more later. The $100 billion here is a floor.

deals.title: Nvidia joins VAST Data's Series F at a $30B valuation

sources.quote: The latest round was led by Drive Capital, with Access Industries acting as co-lead, and included participation from existing investors including Fidelity Management & Research Company, NEA, and NVIDIA, alongside new investors.

deals.explain: Nvidia put more money into VAST Data, a maker of AI data storage software, in a roughly $1 billion round (new shares plus shares sold by existing holders) that valued VAST at $30 billion. Nvidia's own share of the round was not disclosed.

deals.title: Thinking Machines Lab signs multibillion-dollar Google Cloud deal for Nvidia GB300 chips

deals.explain: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab agreed to rent Nvidia GB300-based computing from Google Cloud to train and run its models. Google called it multibillion-dollar; a source told TechCrunch it is in the single-digit billions, but no exact figure was given.

deals.title: Google offers Anthropic up to $30B more in funding

The Alphabet Inc.-owned company will invest another $30 billion if Anthropic hits performance targets

deals.title: Google invests $10B in Anthropic

sources.quote: In March 2026, the Company entered into a financing arrangement, including a note purchase agreement (“Google 2026 NPA”) with Google under which Google purchased 38.6 million shares of the Company’s Series G-2 non-voting redeemable convertible preferred stock for approximately $10.0

deals.explain: Google bought about $10 billion of Anthropic shares in 2026 (the agreement was signed in March and made public on April 24). Google also promised up to $30 billion more if Anthropic hits targets (a separate record).

deals.title: OpenAI to keep paying Microsoft a revenue share through 2030, now capped

sources.quote: Revenue share payments from OpenAI to Microsoft continue through 2030, independent of OpenAI’s technology progress, at the same percentage but subject to a total cap.

deals.explain: In an April 2026 rewrite of their partnership, OpenAI agreed to keep sending Microsoft a share of its revenue through 2030, up to a total cap that was not disclosed. Microsoft stopped paying its own revenue share to OpenAI, and OpenAI became free to sell its products on any cloud.

deals.title: Nvidia signs $3.4B five-year AI cloud contract with IREN

sources.quote: We also signed a 5-year, $3.4bn AI Cloud contract with NVIDIA and entered into a broader strategic partnership that further validates IREN’s key role in the AI infrastructure ecosystem.

In addition, in May 2026 we entered into a five-year cloud services contract with NVIDIA to support its internal AI and research workloads representing approximately $3.4 billion of total contract value.

deals.explain: Nvidia agreed to pay IREN about $3.4 billion over five years to rent cloud computing for its own AI research. IREN buys Nvidia GPUs to provide that service, so money flows both ways.

deals.explain: IREN gave Nvidia the right to buy up to 30 million IREN shares at $70 each (about $2.1 billion) over five years, tied to IREN deploying up to 600,000 Nvidia GPUs. Money only moves if Nvidia exercises the rights.

deals.title: GIC and Coatue co-lead Anthropic's Series H

sources.quote: The round was co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ, and XN.

deals.explain: GIC co-led Anthropic's $65 billion Series H alongside Coatue, ICONIQ and others (counted in full on the Sequoia record). GIC's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Greenoaks among leads of Anthropic's Series H

sources.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.

deals.explain: Greenoaks was one of four leads of Anthropic's $65 billion Series H (counted in full on the Sequoia record). Its own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Sequoia among leads of Anthropic's $65B Series H

sources.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.
It also includes $15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon.

deals.explain: Sequoia was one of four leads of a $65 billion funding round for Anthropic at a $965 billion valuation. The amount shown is the whole round, and $15 billion of it is money cloud giants such as Amazon had already committed; Sequoia's own share was not disclosed.

deals.title: Amazon (AWS) signs second Cipher lease, 70 MW at Stingray (~$2B)

deals.title: AMD Ventures co-leads TensorWave's $350M Series B

sources.quote: The round was co-led by Magnetar and AMD Ventures, with continued participation from Maverick Silicon, Nexus Venture Partners, and Western Frontier.

deals.explain: AMD's venture arm co-led TensorWave's $350 million Series B at a $1.55 billion valuation. The money funds more AMD GPU clusters, so part of it flows back to AMD.

deals.title: SpaceX acquires Cursor maker Anysphere

deals.title: Nvidia joins Together AI's $800M Series C

deals.explain: Nvidia invested again in Together AI's $800 million Series C, which valued the company at about $8.3 billion. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Anthropic signs 20-year lease at TeraWulf's Kentucky campus (~$19B)

deals.title: Fluidstack-led group to buy TeraWulf's 50.1% stake in Abernathy JV

sources.quote: Separately, TeraWulf has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its 50.1% ownership interest in the Abernathy Joint Venture to an investor group led by its joint venture partner, Fluidstack.

deals.explain: An investor group led by Fluidstack agreed to buy TeraWulf's majority stake in their shared Abernathy, Texas data center venture. TeraWulf said the price is a premium to the roughly $450 million it invested, but did not give the exact amount.

deals.title: Perplexity signs multi-year cloud contract with IREN

sources.quote: In July 2026, we entered into multi-year cloud services contracts with leading AI developers including Prometheus, Perplexity and Together AI, representing approximately $2.8 billion in aggregate total contract value.

deals.explain: Perplexity agreed to rent AI computing from IREN for several years. Its share of the $2.8 billion signed with three customers was not disclosed.

deals.title: Together AI signs multi-year cloud contract with IREN

sources.quote: In July 2026, we entered into multi-year cloud services contracts with leading AI developers including Prometheus, Perplexity and Together AI, representing approximately $2.8 billion in aggregate total contract value.

deals.explain: Together AI, itself an AI cloud, agreed to rent GPU capacity from IREN for several years. Its share of the $2.8 billion signed with three customers was not disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia and SK hynix sign long-term AI memory supply partnership

sources.quote: As a follow-up measure to solidify their previous long-term technical partnership, this agreement allows NVIDIA to secure a stable supply of next-generation AI memory, while enabling SK hynix to expand the foundation for growth.
Advancing Next-Generation AI Memory SK hynix is also entering into a long-term AI memory partnership with NVIDIA.

deals.explain: Nvidia signed a long-term deal to secure SK hynix's next-generation AI memory, including HBM, for its chips. It is part of a wider SK–Nvidia plan the companies say is worth more than $500 billion, but no dollar figure was given for the memory part alone, so none is shown here.

deals.title: AMD anchors 15-year, ~530 MW leases at Core Scientific (up to $14B)

sources.quote: Announced a partnership with AMD with the potential to support up to 2.5 GW of leasable capacity, anchored by 15-year agreements for approximately 530 MW across five sites and more than $14 billion of potential base contracted revenue.

Core Scientific (NASDAQ: CORZ) and AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today announced a partnership to shape the future of AI infrastructure, with AMD to secure up to 2.5 gigawatts of data center capacity to support end customer deployments of AMD AI solutions.

Core Scientific values the whole ~530 MW package at more than $14 billion of potential base revenue; AMD's own share was not split out.

deals.title: Nvidia joins Firmus's $2B strategic equity round

sources.quote: The round includes follow-on participation from Coatue and Nvidia, as well as new investment from funds managed by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and other Blackstone vehicles, which the company collectively referred to as Blackstone.

deals.title: TensorWave signs 15-year lease at Fermi's Project Matador (~$6.5B)

deals.title: Nebius leases AI capacity at Vantage's Newport, Wales campus

sources.quote: Under the agreement, Nebius will lease high-density capacity at CWL1 to support AI training, inference, agentic AI and enterprise AI workloads, serving enterprises, researchers, startups and public sector organizations seeking access to advanced AI infrastructure.

deals.explain: AI cloud company Nebius agreed to lease high-density capacity at Vantage's CWL1 campus in Newport, Wales, for Nvidia-based AI servers. Size and value were not disclosed.

deals.title: Google signs 396 MW geothermal PPA with Fervo's Cape Station

sources.quote: Fervo Energy (Nasdaq: FRVO), a global pioneer of next-generation geothermal energy, today announced a 396-megawatt (MW) power purchase agreement (PPA) with Google to enable the continued development of the Cape Station enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) GeoCluster, expected to come online in 2028.

deals.explain: Google will buy 396 MW of round-the-clock geothermal power from Fervo's Cape Station in Utah (online from 2028) for a potential Utah data center, with an option to expand to nearly 1 GW. Price not disclosed. Plant: Cape Station, Beaver County, Utah.

deals.title: Nvidia backs Crusoe's $3.9B Series F

sources.quote: The oversubscribed round was co-led by Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital, and Valor Equity Partners, alongside significant backing from new and existing investors including Founders Fund, GIC, NVIDIA, Qatar Investment Authority (QIA), Radical Ventures, and TPG.

deals.explain: Nvidia invested again in Crusoe's $3.9 billion Series F at a $30.9 billion valuation; its own amount was not disclosed.

deals.title: Nvidia commits $1B in Nscale pre-IPO convertible notes

sources.quote: "With the backing of these world-class investors, we are strongly positioned to accelerate our data center buildouts globally."The financing consists of an initial $2.36bn tranche at closing and an additional $1bn commitment from NVIDIA with funding expected in mid-November, 2026.

deals.explain: Nvidia committed $1 billion to Nscale through convertible loan notes, a loan that turns into shares when Nscale goes public. The money was expected to arrive in mid-November 2026.
